 15569                                  ;Break <SetExtent - update the extent/NR field>
 15570                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15571                                  ;
 15572                                  ;   SetExtent - change the position of an FCB by filling in the extent/NR
 15573                                  ;	fields
 15574                                  ;
 15575                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI point to FCB
 15576                                  ;		DX:AX is a record location in file
 15577                                  ;   Outputs:	Extent/NR fields are filled in
 15578                                  ;   Registers modified: CX
 15579                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15580                                  
 15581                                  SetExtent:
 15582 000021C8 50                      	push	ax
 15583 000021C9 52                      	push	dx
 15584 000021CA 89C1                    	MOV	CX,AX
 15585 000021CC 247F                    	AND	AL,7FH			; next rec field
 15586                                  	;mov	[si+20h],al
 15587 000021CE 884420                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.NR],AL
 15588 000021D1 80E180                  	AND	CL,80H			; save upper bit
 15589 000021D4 D1E1                    	SHL	CX,1
 15590 000021D6 D1D2                    	RCL	DX,1			; move high bit of CX to low bit of DX
 15591 000021D8 88E8                    	MOV	AL,CH
 15592 000021DA 88D4                    	MOV	AH,DL
 15593                                  	;mov	[si+0Ch], ax
 15594 000021DC 89440C                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.EXTENT],AX	; all done
 15595 000021DF 5A                      	pop	dx
 15596 000021E0 58                      	pop	ax
 15597 000021E1 C3                      	retn

 16319                                  
 16320                                  ; We must scan the set of FCB SFTs for one that appears to match the current
 16321                                  ; one.	We cheat and use CheckFCB to match the FCBs.
 16322                                  
 16323                                  ;hkn; 	SS override
 16324 0000246F 36C43E[4000]            	LES	DI,[SS:SFTFCB]		; get the pointer to head of the list
 16325                                  	;mov	ah,[es:di+4]
 16326 00002474 268A6504                	MOV	AH,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]	; get number of SFTs to scan
 16327                                  OpenScan:
 16328                                  	;cmp	al,[si+18h]
 16329 00002478 3A4418                  	CMP	AL,[SI+fcb_sfn]		; don't compare ourselves
 16330 0000247B 7407                    	JZ	short SkipCheck
 16331 0000247D 50                      	push	ax			; preserve count
 16332 0000247E E848FC                  	call	CheckFCB		; do they match
 16333 00002481 58                      	pop	ax			; get count back
 16334 00002482 7309                    	JNC	short OpenFound		; found a match!
 16335                                  SkipCheck:
 16336 00002484 FEC0                    	INC	AL			; advance to next FCB
 16337 00002486 38E0                    	CMP	AL,AH			; table full?
 16338 00002488 75EE                    	JNZ	short OpenScan		; no, go for more
 16339                                  OpenDone:
 16340 0000248A 30C0                    	xor	al,al			; return success
 16341 0000248C C3                      	retn
 16342                                  
 16343                                  ; The SFT at ES:DI is the one that is already in use for this FCB. We set the
 16344                                  ; FCB to use this one. We increment its ref count. We do NOT close it at all.
 16345                                  ; Consider:
 16346                                  ;
 16347                                  ;   open (foo)	delete (foo) open (bar)
 16348                                  ;
 16349                                  ; This causes us to recycle (potentially) bar through the same local SFT as
 16350                                  ; foo even though foo is no longer needed; this is due to the server closing
 16351                                  ; foo for us when we delete it. Unfortunately, we cannot see this closure.
 16352                                  ; If we were to CLOSE bar, the server would then close the only reference to
 16353                                  ; bar and subsequent I/O would be lost to the redirector.
 16354                                  ;
 16355                                  ; This gets solved by NOT closing the sft, but zeroing the ref count
 16356                                  ; (effectively freeing the SFT) and informing the sharer (if relevant) that
 16357                                  ; the SFT is no longer in use. Note that the SHARER MUST keep its ref counts
 16358                                  ; around. This will allow us to access the same file through multiple network
 16359                                  ; connections and NOT prematurely terminate when the ref count on one
 16360                                  ; connection goes to zero.
 16361                                  
 16362                                  OpenFound:
 16363                                  	;mov	[si+18h],al
 16364 0000248D 884418                  	MOV	[SI+fcb_sfn],AL 	; assign with this
 16365 00002490 26FF05                  	inc	word [es:di]
 16366                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 16367                                  					; remember this new invocation
 16368                                  	; 23/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 16369                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 16370                                  	;;;
 16371 00002493 E8C923                  	call	set_sftfcb_entry
 16372                                  	;;;
 16373                                  
 16374                                  	; 24/01/2024
 16375 00002496 16                      	push	ss
 16376 00002497 1F                      	pop	ds
 16377                                  	
 16378                                  	;MOV	AX,[SS:FCBLRU]		; update LRU counts
 16379 00002498 A1[1000]                	mov	ax,[FCBLRU] ; 24/01/2024
 16380                                  	;mov	[es:di+15h],ax
 16381 0000249B 26894515                	MOV	[ES:DI+sf_LRU],AX
 16382                                  ;
 16383                                  ; We have an FCB sft that is now of no use. We release sharing info and then
 16384                                  ; blast it to prevent other reuse.
 16385                                  ;
 16386                                  	;push	ss
 16387                                  	;pop	ds
 16388                                  	
 16389 0000249F C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 16390 000024A3 26FF0D                  	dec	word [es:di]
 16391                                  	;DEC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 16392                                  					; free the newly allocated SFT
 16393 000024A6 E8EB5B                  	call	ShareEnd
 16394 000024A9 B043                    	MOV	AL,'C'	 ; 43h
 16395 000024AB E802FC                  	call	BlastSFT
 16396 000024AE EBDA                    	JMP	short OpenDone

 16451                                  ; Procedure Name : $DIR_SEARCH_FIRST
 16452                                  ;
 16453                                  ; Inputs:
 16454                                  ;	DS:DX Points to unopenned FCB
 16455                                  ; Function:
 16456                                  ;	Directory is searched for first matching entry and the directory
 16457                                  ;	entry is loaded at the disk transfer address
 16458                                  ; Returns:
 16459                                  ;	AL = -1 if no entries matched, otherwise 0

 16462                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3) - Offset 2B88h
 16463

 16466                                  	; MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:5DDFh

 17144                                  ;BREAK <$ChDir -- Change current directory on a drive>
 17145                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17146                                  ;
 17147                                  ; $ChDir - Top-level change directory system call.  This call is responsible
 17148                                  ; for setting up the CDS for the specified drive appropriately.  There are
 17149                                  ; several cases to consider:
 17150                                  ;
 17151                                  ;   o	Local, simple CDS.  In this case, we take the input path and convert
 17152                                  ;	it into a WFP.	We verify the existance of this directory and then
 17153                                  ;	copy the WFP into the CDS and set up the ID field to point to the
 17154                                  ;	directory cluster.
 17155                                  ;   o	Net CDS.  We form the path from the root (including network prefix)
 17156                                  ;	and verify its existance (via DOS_Chdir).  If successful, we copy the
 17157                                  ;	WFP back into the CDS.
 17158                                  ;   o	SUBST'ed CDS.  This is no different than the local, simple CDS.
 17159                                  ;   o	JOIN'ed CDS.  This is trouble as there are two CDS's at work.  If we
 17160                                  ;	call TransPath, we will get the PHYSICAL CDS that the path refers to
 17161                                  ;	and the PHYSICAL WFP that the input path refers to.  This is perfectly
 17162                                  ;	good for the validation but not for currency.  We call TransPathNoSet
 17163                                  ;	to process the path but to return the logical CDS and the logical
 17164                                  ;	path.  We then copy the logical path into the logical CDS.
 17165                                  ;
 17166                                  ; Inputs:
 17167                                  ;	DS:DX Points to asciz name
 17168                                  ; Returns:
 17169                                  ;	STD XENIX Return
 17170                                  ;	AX = chdir_path_not_found if error
 17171                                  ;
 17172                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17173                                  	
 17174                                  	; 25/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 17175                                  	
 17176                                  _$CHDIR:
 17177                                  	; 25/01/2024
 17178                                  	;;;
 17179 00002724 36C606[0C11]43          	mov	byte [ss:PATHNAMELEN],67 ; Retro DOS v5.0
 17180                                  	;mov	word [ss:PATHNAMELEN],67 ; DIRSTRLEN = 67
 17181                                  	;;;
 17182 0000272A BF[BE03]                	MOV	DI,OPENBUF		; spot for translated name
 17183 0000272D 89D6                    	MOV	SI,DX			; get source
 17184 0000272F E83C51                  	call	TransPath		; go munge the path and get real CDS
 17185 00002732 7304                    	JNC	short ChDirCrack	; no errors, try path
 17186                                  ChDirErrP:

 17441                                  
 17442                                  ;**	IOCTL system call.
 17443                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17444                                  ;	$IOCTL
 17445                                  ;
 17446                                  ;	  Revision history:
 17447                                  ;
 17448                                  ;		Created: ARR 4 April 1983
 17449                                  ;
 17450                                  ;		GenericIOCTL added:		KGS	22 April 1985
 17451                                  ;
 17452                                  ;		A000	version 4.00	Jan. 1988
 17453                                  ;
 17454                                  ;		Used jump table to dispatch IOCTL functions. HKN 3/12/90
 17455                                  ;
 17456                                  
 17457                                  ;BREAK <IOCTL - munge on a handle to do device specific stuff>
 17458                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17459                                  ;
 17460                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 17461                                  ;	    MOV     BX, Handle
 17462                                  ;	    MOV     DX, Data
 17463                                  ;
 17464                                  ;	(or LDS     DX,BUF
 17465                                  ;	    MOV     CX,COUNT)
 17466                                  ;
 17467                                  ;	    MOV     AH, Ioctl
 17468                                  ;	    MOV     AL, Request
 17469                                  ;	    INT     21h
 17470                                  ;
 17471                                  ;   AH = 0  Return a combination of low byte of sf_flags and device driver
 17472                                  ;	    attribute word in DX, handle in BX:
 17473                                  ;	    DH = high word of device driver attributes
 17474                                  ;	    DL = low byte of sf_flags
 17475                                  ;	 1  Set the bits contained in DX to sf_flags.  DH MUST be 0.  Handle
 17476                                  ;	    in BX.
 17477                                  ;	 2  Read CX bytes from the device control channel for handle in BX
 17478                                  ;	    into DS:DX.  Return number read in AX.
 17479                                  ;	 3  Write CX bytes to the device control channel for handle in BX from
 17480                                  ;	    DS:DX.  Return bytes written in AX.
 17481                                  ;	 4  Read CX bytes from the device control channel for drive in BX
 17482                                  ;	    into DS:DX.  Return number read in AX.
 17483                                  ;	 5  Write CX bytes to the device control channel for drive in BX from
 17484                                  ;	    DS:DX.  Return bytes written in AX.
 17485                                  ;	 6  Return input status of handle in BX. If a read will go to the
 17486                                  ;	    device, AL = 0FFh, otherwise 0.
 17487                                  ;	 7  Return output status of handle in BX. If a write will go to the
 17488                                  ;	    device, AL = 0FFh, otherwise 0.
 17489                                  ;	 8  Given a drive in BX, return 1 if the device contains non-
 17490                                  ;	    removable media, 0 otherwise.
 17491                                  ;	 9  Return the contents of the device attribute word in DX for the
 17492                                  ;	    drive in BX.  0200h is the bit for shared.	1000h is the bit for
 17493                                  ;	    network. 8000h is the bit for local use.
 17494                                  ;	 A  Return 8000h if the handle in BX is for the network or not.
 17495                                  ;	 B  Change the retry delay and the retry count for the system. BX is
 17496                                  ;	    the count and CX is the delay.
 17497                                  ;
 17498                                  ;   Error returns:
 17499                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_handle
 17500                                  ;	       = error_invalid_function
 17501                                  ;	       = error_invalid_data
 17502                                  ;
 17503                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17504                                  ;
 17505                                  ;   This is the documentation copied from DOS 4.0 it is much better
 17506                                  ;   than the above
 17507                                  ;
 17508                                  ;	There are several basic forms of IOCTL calls:
 17509                                  ;
 17510                                  ;
 17511                                  ;	** Get/Set device information:	**
 17512                                  ;
 17513                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17514                                  ;		  0 - Get device information
 17515                                  ;		  1 - Set device information
 17516                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17517                                  ;		(DX) = info for "Set Device Information"
 17518                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17519                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17520                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17521                                  ;		  (DX) = info for "Get Device Information"
 17522                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17523                                  ;
 17524                                  ;
 17525                                  ;	**  Read/Write Control Data From/To Handle  **
 17526                                  ;
 17527                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17528                                  ;		  2 - Read device control info
 17529                                  ;		  3 - Write device control info
 17530                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17531                                  ;		(CX) = transfer count
 17532                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data
 17533                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17534                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17535                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17536                                  ;		  (AX) = count of bytes transfered
 17537                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17538                                  ;
 17539                                  ;
 17540                                  ;	**  Read/Write Control Data From/To Block Device  **
 17541                                  ;
 17542                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17543                                  ;		  4 - Read device control info
 17544                                  ;		  5 - Write device control info
 17545                                  ;		(BL) = Drive number (0=default, 1='A', 2='B', etc)
 17546                                  ;		(CX) = transfer count
 17547                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data
 17548                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17549                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17550                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17551                                  ;		  (AX) = count of bytes transfered
 17552                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17553                                  ;
 17554                                  ;
 17555                                  ;	**  Get Input/Output Status  **
 17556                                  ;
 17557                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17558                                  ;		  6 - Get Input status
 17559                                  ;		  7 - Get Output Status
 17560                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17561                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17562                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17563                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17564                                  ;		  (AL) = 00 if not ready
 17565                                  ;		  (AL) = FF if ready
 17566                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17567                                  ;
 17568                                  ;
 17569                                  ;	**  Get Drive Information  **
 17570                                  ;
 17571                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17572                                  ;		  8 - Check for removable media
 17573                                  ;		  9 - Get device attributes
 17574                                  ;		(BL) = Drive number (0=default, 1='A', 2='B', etc)
 17575                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17576                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17577                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17578                                  ;		  (AX) = 0/1 media is removable/fixed (func. 8)
 17579                                  ;		  (DX) = device attribute word (func. 9)
 17580                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17581                                  ;
 17582                                  ;
 17583                                  ;	**  Get Redirected bit	**
 17584                                  ;
 17585                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17586                                  ;		  0Ah - Network stuff
 17587                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 17588                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17589                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17590                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17591                                  ;		  (DX) = SFT flags word, 8000h set if network file
 17592                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17593                                  ;
 17594                                  ;
 17595                                  ;	**  Change sharer retry parameters  **
 17596                                  ;
 17597                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17598                                  ;		  0Bh - Set retry parameters
 17599                                  ;		(CX) = retry loop count
 17600                                  ;		(DX) = number of retries
 17601                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17602                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17603                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17604                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17605                                  ;
 17606                                  ;
 17607                                  ;   =================================================================
 17608                                  ;
 17609                                  ;	**  New Standard Control  **
 17610                                  ;
 17611                                  ;	ALL NEW IOCTL FACILITIES SHOULD USE THIS FORM.	THE OTHER
 17612                                  ;	FORMS ARE OBSOLETE.
 17613                                  ;
 17614                                  ;   =================================================================
 17615                                  ;
 17616                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17617                                  ;		  0Ch - Control Function subcode
 17618                                  ;		(BX) = File Handle
 17619                                  ;		(CH) = Category Indicator
 17620                                  ;		(CL) = Function within category
 17621                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data, if any
 17622                                  ;		(SI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17623                                  ;		(DI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17624                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17625                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17626                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17627                                  ;		  (SI) = Return value, meaning is function dependent
 17628                                  ;		  (DI) = Return value, meaning is function dependent
 17629                                  ;		  (DS:DX) = Return address, use is function dependent
 17630                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17631                                  ;
 17632                                  ;    ============== Generic IOCTL Definitions for DOS 3.2 ============
 17633                                  ;     (See inc\ioctl.inc for more info)
 17634                                  ;
 17635                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 17636                                  ;		  0Dh - Control Function subcode
 17637                                  ;		(BL) = Drive Number (0 = Default, 1= 'A')
 17638                                  ;		(CH) = Category Indicator
 17639                                  ;		(CL) = Function within category
 17640                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data, if any
 17641                                  ;		(SI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17642                                  ;		(DI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 17643                                  ;
 17644                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 17645                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 17646                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 17647                                  ;		  (DS:DX) = Return address, use is function dependent
 17648                                  ;	USES	ALL
 17649                                  ;
 17650                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17651                                  	
 17652                                  	; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 17653                                  	; DOSCODE:611Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 17654                                  
 17655                                  	; 11/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 17656                                  	; DOSCODE:610Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 17657

 18412                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18413                                  ; Proc Name : Check_If_Net:
 18414                                  ;
 18415                                  ;
 18416                                  ; Checks if the device is over the net or not. Returns result in ZERO flag.
 18417                                  ; If no device is found, the return address is popped off the stack, and a
 18418                                  ; jump is made to ioctl_drv_err.
 18419                                  ;
 18420                                  ; On Entry:
 18421                                  ; Registers same as those for Get_Driver_BL
 18422                                  ;
 18423                                  ; On Exit:
 18424                                  ; ZERO flag	- set if not a net device
 18425                                  ;		- reset if net device
 18426                                  ; ES:DI -> the device
 18427                                  ;
 18428                                  ;
 18429                                  ; BUGBUG: This function assumes the following stack setup on entry
 18430                                  ;
 18431                                  ;	  SP+2 -> Error return address
 18432                                  ;	  SP   -> Normal return address
 18433                                  ;
 18434                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18435                                  
 18436                                  	; 30/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 18437                                  	; MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:639Ch
 18438                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:6A91h
 18439                                  	; Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:68E1h
 18440                                  
 18441                                  Check_If_Net:
 18442                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 18443 00002AA8 E8D2FF                  	CALL	Get_Driver_BL
 18444 00002AAB 7201                    	JC	short ioctl_drv_err_pop	; invalid drive letter
 18445                                  
 18446                                  ; 30/01/2024 ('Get_Driver_BL' returns with
 18447                                  ;	      'curdir_isnet' condition/ZF, no need to a second test)
 18448                                  %if 0
 18449                                  	;;;
 18450                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM, Windows ME IO.SYS)
 18451                                  	PUSH	ES
 18452                                  	PUSH	DI
 18453                                  	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 18454                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],8000h
 18455                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_isnet
 18456                                  	;test	byte [es:di+44h],80h
 18457                                  	TEST	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],(curdir_isnet>>8)
 18458                                  	POP	DI
 18459                                  	POP	ES
 18460                                  	;;;
 18461                                  %endif

 18545                                  ;**	DELETE.ASM - Low level routine for deleting files
 18546                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18547                                  ;		DOS_DELETE
 18548                                  ;		REN_DEL_Check
 18549                                  ;		FastOpen_Delete	       ; DOS 3.3
 18550                                  ;		FastOpen_Update	       ; DOS 3.3
 18551                                  
 18552                                  ;   Revision history:
 18553                                  ;
 18554                                  ;   A000  version 4.00	Jan. 1988
 18555                                  ;   A001  Fastopen Rename fix	April 1989
 18556                                  
 18557                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 18558                                  
 18559                                  ;	i_need	NoSetDir,BYTE
 18560                                  ;	i_need	Creating,BYTE
 18561                                  ;	i_need	DELALL,BYTE
 18562                                  ;	i_need	THISDPB,DWORD
 18563                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 18564                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 18565                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 18566                                  ;	i_need	ATTRIB,BYTE
 18567                                  ;	i_need	SATTRIB,BYTE

 18576                                  ;	i_need	FastTable,BYTE			  ; DOS 4.00
 18577                                  ;

 18579                                  ;

 18582                                  ;	i_need	RENAMEDMA,BYTE
 18583                                  
 18584                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18585                                  ;
 18586                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DELETE
 18587                                  ;
 18588                                  ; Inputs:
 18589                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18590                                  ;		terminated)
 18591                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18592                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18593                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 18594                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 18595                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 18596                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18597                                  ; Function:
 18598                                  ;	Delete the specified file(s)
 18599                                  ; Outputs:
 18600                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 18601                                  ;		OK
 18602                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18603                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18604                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 18605                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 18606                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18607                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18608                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18609                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18610                                  ;		error_access_denied
 18611                                  ;			Attempt to delete device or directory
 18612                                  ;		***error_sharing_violation***
 18613                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 18614                                  ;			This error is NOT returned. The INT 24H is generated,
 18615                                  ;			  and the file is ignored (not deleted). Delete will
 18616                                  ;			  simply continue on looking for more files.
 18617                                  ;			  Carry will NOT be set in this case.
 18618                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 18619                                  ;
 18620                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18621                                  
 18622                                  FILEFOUND   equ 01h
 18623                                  FILEDELETED equ 10h
 18624                                  
 18625                                  	; 12/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 18626                                  	; DOSCODE:63E9h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 18627                                  
 18628                                  	; 30/01/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IBMDOS.COM)
 18629                                  	; DOSCODE:6B11h (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 18630                                  
 18631                                  DOS_DELETE:
 18632

 18921                                  ; Procedure Name : REN_DEL_Check
 18922                                  ;
 18923                                  ; Inputs:
 18924                                  ;	[THISDPB] set

 18926                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI points to firclus field of entry

 18934                                  ;		last element will be loaded from the directory entry. This is

 19058                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_RENAME - Internal RENAME call for MS-DOS
 19059                                  ;	NAME	DOS_RENAME
 19060                                  
 19061                                  ;**	Low level routine for renaming files
 19062                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19063                                  ;	DOS_RENAME
 19064                                  ;
 19065                                  ;	Modification history:
 19066                                  ;
 19067                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19068                                  
 19069                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19070                                  ;
 19071                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_RENAME
 19072                                  ;
 19073                                  ; Inputs:
 19074                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to SOURCE WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 19075                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 19076                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string [SOURCE]
 19077                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 19078                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)

 19846                                  ;		error_access_denied

 19999                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DUP
 20000                                  ;
 20001                                  ; Inputs:
 20002                                  ;	[THISSFT] set to the SFT for the file being DUPed
 20003                                  ;		(a non net SFT is OK, in this case the ref
 20004                                  ;		 count is simply incremented)
 20005                                  ; Function:
 20006                                  ;	Signal to the devices that a logical open is occurring
 20007                                  ; Returns:
 20008                                  ;	ES:DI point to SFT
 20009                                  ;    Carry clear
 20010                                  ;	SFT ref_count is incremented
 20011                                  ; Registers modified: None.
 20012                                  ; NOTE:
 20013                                  ;	This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK at DOSINIT
 20014                                  ;	time with SS NOT DOSGROUP. There will be no Network handles at
 20015                                  ;	that time.
 20016                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20017                                  
 20018                                  DOS_DUP:
 20019                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:THISSFT]  ; MSDOS 3.3
 20020                                  
 20021                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 20022 00002FDD 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 20023 00002FE2 26C43E[9E05]            	les	di,[es:THISSFT]
 20024                                  
 20025                                  	;Entry	Dos_Dup_Direct
 20026                                  DOS_Dup_Direct:
 20027 00002FE7 E82BE8                  	call	IsSFTNet
 20028 00002FEA 7503                    	JNZ	short DO_INC
 20029 00002FEC E8941E                  	call	DEV_OPEN_SFT
 20030                                  DO_INC:
 20031                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 20032 00002FEF 26FF05                  	inc	word [ES:DI]		; Clears carry (if this ever wraps
 20033                                  					;   we're in big trouble anyway)
 20034 00002FF2 C3                      	retn

 20075                                  ;***	DOS_CREATE - Create a File
 20076                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20077                                  ;	DOS_Create is called to create the specified file, truncating
 20078                                  ;	the old one if it exists.
 20079                                  ;
 20080                                  ;	ENTRY	AX is Attribute to create
 20081                                  ;		(ds) = DOSDATA
 20082                                  ;		[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 20083                                  ;			terminated)
 20084                                  ;		[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 20085                                  ;			( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 20086                                  ;			 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 20087                                  ;		[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 20088                                  ;			(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 20089                                  ;		[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 20090                                  ;			(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 20091                                  ;		[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 20092                                  ;
 20093                                  ;	EXIT	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 20094                                  ;		CARRY CLEAR
 20095                                  ;		    THISSFT filled in.
 20096                                  ;			sf_mode = unchanged for FCB, sharing_compat + open_for_both
 20097                                  ;		CARRY SET
 20098                                  ;		    AX is error code
 20099                                  ;			error_path_not_found
 20100                                  ;				Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 20101                                  ;			error_bad_curr_dir
 20102                                  ;				Bad path in current directory part of path
 20103                                  ;			error_access_denied
 20104                                  ;				Attempt to re-create read only file , or
 20105                                  ;				create a second volume id or create a dir
 20106                                  ;			error_sharing_violation
 20107                                  ;				The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 20108                                  ;				generates an INT 24
 20109                                  ;	USES	all but DS
 20110                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20111                                  
 20112                                  	; 14/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 20113                                  	; DOSCODE:6920h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 20362                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20363                                  ; Procedure Name : Dos_Create_New
 20364                                  ;
 20365                                  ; Inputs:
 20366                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 20367                                  ;		terminated)
 20368                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 20369                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 20370                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 20371                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 20372                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 20373                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 20374                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 20375                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 20376                                  ;	AX is Attribute to create
 20377                                  ; Function:
 20378                                  ;	Try to create the specified file truncating an old one that exists
 20379                                  ; Outputs:
 20380                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 20381                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 20382                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 20383                                  ;		sf_mode = sharing_compat + open_for_both for Non-FCB SFT
 20384                                  ;	CARRY SET
 20385                                  ;	    AX is error code
 20386                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 20387                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 20388                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 20389                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 20390                                  ;		error_access_denied
 20391                                  ;			Create a second volume id or create a dir
 20392                                  ;		error_file_exists
 20393                                  ;			Already a file by this name
 20394                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 20395                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20396                                  
 20397                                  DOS_Create_New:
 20398 000030B7 B401                    	MOV	AH,1		; Truncate is NOT OK
 20399 000030B9 E939FF                  	JMP	Create_inter

 20404                                  ;
 20405                                  ; Inputs:

 20554                                  ; 08/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 20555                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 20556                                  
 20557                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_OPEN - Internal OPEN call for MS-DOS
 20558                                  ;	NAME	DOS_OPEN
 20559                                  
 20560                                  ;**	OPEN.ASM - File Open
 20561                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20562                                  ;	Low level routines for openning a file from a file spec.
 20563                                  ;	Also misc routines for sharing errors
 20564                                  ;
 20565                                  ;	DOS_Open
 20566                                  ;	Check_Access_AX
 20567                                  ;	SHARE_ERROR
 20568                                  ;	SET_SFT_MODE
 20569                                  ;	Code_Page_Mismatched_Error		   ; DOS 4.00
 20570                                  ;
 20571                                  ;	Revision history:
 20572                                  ;
 20573                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 20574                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00   Jan. 1988
 20575                                  ;
 20576                                  ;	M034 - The value in save_bx must be pushed on to the stack for
 20577                                  ; 	       remote extended opens and not save_cx.
 20578                                  ;
 20579                                  ;	M035 - if open made from exec then we must set the appropriate bits
 20580                                  ;	       on the stack before calling off to the redir.
 20581                                  ;	M042 - Bit 11 of DOS34_FLAG set indicates that the redir knows how 
 20582                                  ;	       to handle open from exec. In this case set the appropriate bit
 20583                                  ;	       else do not.
 20584                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------	
 20585

 20587

 20591                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 20592                                  ;	i_need	CurrentPDB,WORD
 20593                                  ;	i_need	CURR_DIR_END,WORD
 20594                                  ;	I_need	RetryCount,WORD
 20595                                  ;	I_need	Open_Access,BYTE
 20596                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE
 20597                                  ;	i_need	JShare,DWORD
 20598                                  ;	I_need	FastOpenFlg,byte
 20599                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20600                                  ;	I_need	ALLOWED,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20601                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20602                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_LOCUS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20603                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_ACTION,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20604                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_CLASS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20605                                  ;	I_need	CPSWFLAG,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20606                                  ;	I_need	EXITHOLD,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20607                                  ;	I_need	THISDPB,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20608                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_CX,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 20609                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ;M034
 20610                                  ;
 20611                                  ;	I_need	DOS_FLAG,BYTE
 20612                                  ;	I_need	DOS34_FLAG,WORD			  ;M042
 20613                                  
 20614                                  ;Break	<DOS_Open - internal file access>
 20615                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20616                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_Open
 20617                                  ;
 20618                                  ; Inputs:
 20619                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 20620                                  ;		terminated)
 20621                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 20622                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 20623                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 20624                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 20625                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 20626                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file found
 20627                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 20628                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 20629                                  ;	AX is Access and Sharing mode
 20630                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 20631                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 20632                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 20633                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 20634                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 20635                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 20636                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 20637                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 20638                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 20639                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 20640                                  ;
 20641                                  ;	  For FCB SFTs AL should = sharing_compat + open_for_both
 20642                                  ;		(not checked)
 20643                                  ; Function:
 20644                                  ;	Try to open the specified file
 20645                                  ; Outputs:
 20646                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 20647                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 20648                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 20649                                  ;	CARRY SET
 20650                                  ;	    AX is error code
 20651                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 20652                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 20653                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 20654                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 20655                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 20656                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 20657                                  ;		error_invalid_access
 20658                                  ;			Bad sharing mode or bad access mode or bad combination
 20659                                  ;		error_access_denied
 20660                                  ;			Attempt to open read only file for writting, or
 20661                                  ;			open a directory
 20662                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 20663                                  ;			The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 20664                                  ;			generates an INT 24 on compatibility mode SFTs
 20665                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 20666                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20667                                  
 20668                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 20669                                  ; DOSCODE:6A60h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 20670                                  ; 14/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 20671                                  ; DOSCODE:6A4Ch (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 20672                                  
 20673                                  ; 01/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 20674                                  ; DOSCODE:71BBh (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 20675

 20700                                  _IFS_extopen:									;AN000;

 20702                                  					    ; with which call was made. This
 20703                                  					    ; has the open access bits.

 20711 00003150 5B                      	POP	BX			    ;FT. trash bx			;AN000;

 20713

 20722

 20726                                  					; Y: check to see if redir is aware
 20727                                  					;    of this 
 20728

 20731 0000315E F606[1206]08            	test	byte [DOS34_FLAG+1],(EXEC_AWARE_REDIR>>8)

 20733                                  					;    this

 20735                                  					; Y: set bit 3 of access byte and 
 20736                                  					;    set sharing mode to DENY_WRITE
 20737                                  					; M042 - end
 20738

 20740                                  	; under the "NOT Installed" conditional. Currently Installed is 
 20741                                  	; always one.

 20751                                  	;INT	2FH
 20752

 20755                                  			; ES:DI -> uninitialized SFT, SS = DOS CS
 20756                                  			; SDA first filename pointer -> fully-qualified name of file to open
 20757                                  			; STACK: WORD file open mode
 20758                                  			; Return: CF set on error
 20759

 20761                                  ;do_ret_label: ; 09/08/2018
 20762 0000316E C3                      	retn
 20763                                  ;ENDIF

 20805                                  OpenBadRet:

 20826                                  Open_found:
 20827 0000319F 74F9                    	JZ	short Open_Bad_Access 	; test for directories
 20828 000031A1 08E4                    	OR	AH,AH
 20829 000031A3 783E                    	JS	short open_ok		; Devices don't have attributes
 20830 000031A5 8E06[E405]              	MOV	ES,[CURBUF+2]		; get buffer location
 20831                                  	;mov	al,[es:bx+0Bh]
 20832 000031A9 268A470B                	MOV	AL,[ES:BX+dir_entry.dir_attr]
 20833 000031AD A808                    	TEST	AL,attr_volume_id	; can't open volume ids
 20834 000031AF 75E9                    	JNZ	short Open_Bad_Access
 20835 000031B1 A801                    	TEST	AL,attr_read_only	; check write on read only
 20836 000031B3 742E                    	JZ	short open_ok
 20837                                  
 20838                                  ; The file is marked READ-ONLY. We verify that the open mode allows access to
 20839                                  ; the read-only file. Unfortunately, with FCB's and net-FCB's we cannot
 20840                                  ; determine at the OPEN time if such access is allowed. Thus, we defer such
 20841                                  ; processing until the actual write operation:
 20842                                  ;
 20843                                  ; If FCB, then we change the mode to be read_only.
 20844                                  ; If net_FCB, then we change the mode to be read_only.
 20845                                  ; If not open for read then error.
 20846                                  
 20847 000031B5 1E                      	push	ds
 20848 000031B6 56                      	push	si
 20849 000031B7 C536[9E05]              	LDS	SI,[THISSFT]
 20850                                  	;mov	cx,[si+2]
 20851 000031BB 8B4C02                  	MOV	CX,[SI+SF_ENTRY.sf_mode]
 20852                                  	; 17/12/2022
 20853                                  	;test	ch,80h
 20854 000031BE F6C580                  	test	ch,sf_isFCB>>8
 20855                                  	;TEST	CX,sf_isFCB ; 8000h	; is it FCB?
 20856 000031C1 750A                    	JNZ	short ResetAccess	; yes, reset the access
 20857 000031C3 88CA                    	MOV	DL,CL
 20858 000031C5 80E2F0                  	AND	DL,SHARING_MASK	; 0F0h
 20859 000031C8 80FA70                  	CMP	DL,SHARING_NET_FCB ; 70h ; is it net FCB?
 20860 000031CB 7508                    	JNZ	short NormalOpen	; no
 20861                                  ResetAccess:
 20862                                  	; 14/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)	
 20863                                  	;AND	CX,~access_mask	; 0FFF0h ; clear access
 20864                                  	; 16/12/2022
 20865                                  	;and	cl,0F0h ; 18/05/2019
 20866                                  	;;;
 20867                                  	; 01/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 20868                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 20869                                  	;and	cx,0FFFCh
 20870 000031CD 80E1FC                  	and	cl,0FCh ; ~3 ; ~open_mode_mask ; clear access
 20871                                  	;;;
 20872                                  ;	OR	CX,open_for_read ; 0	; stick in open_for_read
 20873 000031D0 894C02                  	MOV	[SI+SF_ENTRY.sf_mode],CX
 20874 000031D3 EB0C                    	JMP	SHORT FillSFT
 20875                                  
 20876                                  ; The SFT is normal. See if the requested access is open_for_read
 20877                                  
 20878                                  NormalOpen:
 20879                                  	;AND	CL,access_mask	; 0Fh	; remove extras
 20880                                  	;;;
 20881                                  	; 01/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 20882                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 20883 000031D5 80E103                  	and     cl,3		; it was 'and cl,0Fh' in MSDOS 6.22
 20884                                  				; (and cl,access_mask)
 20885                                  				; this may be open_mode_mask
 20886                                  	;;;
 20887 000031D8 80F900                  	CMP	CL,open_for_read ; 0	; is it open for read?
 20888 000031DB 7404                    	JZ	short FillSFT	; yes
 20889 000031DD 5E                      	pop	si
 20890 000031DE 1F                      	pop	ds
 20891 000031DF EBB9                    	JMP	short Open_Bad_Access
 20892                                  ;
 20893                                  ; All done, restore registers and fill the SFT.
 20894                                  ;
 20895                                  FillSFT:
 20896 000031E1 5E                      	pop	si
 20897 000031E2 1F                      	pop	ds
 20898                                  open_ok:
 20899 000031E3 E87B20                  	call	DOOPEN			; Fill in SFT
 20900                                  
 20901                                  ;hkn; FastOpenFlg is in DOSDATA. use SS override
 20902                                  	; 18/05/2019
 20903                                  	;and	byte [ss:FastOpenFlag],80h
 20904                                  	; 03/03/2025 (MiniDOS)
 20905                                  	;AND	BYTE [SS:FastOpenFlg],Fast_yes	;; DOS 3.3
 20906                                  	; 12/08/2018
 20907                                  	;and	byte [FastOpenFlg],Fast_yes	
 20908                                  
 20909                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 20910 000031E6 E84300                  	CALL	DO_SHARE_CHECK
 20911 000031E9 7303                    	JNC	short SHARE_OK
 20912                                  	;call	LCritDisk
 20913                                  	; 16/12/2022
 20914 000031EB E9B9E6                  	jmp	LCritDisk
 20915                                  
 20916                                  SHARE_OK:
 20917                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 20918 000031EE B80300                  	MOV	AX,3
 20919 000031F1 C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 20920                                  ;if installed
 20921                                  	;call	JShare + 14 * 4
 20922 000031F5 FF1E[C800]              	call	far [JShare+(14*4)]  ; 14 = ShSU
 20923                                  ;else
 20924                                  ;	Call	ShSU
 20925                                  ;endif
 20926 000031F9 E8ABE6                  	call	LCritDisk
 20927                                  	
 20928                                  	;FallThru Set_SFT_Mode
 20929                                  
 20930                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20931                                  ; Procedure Name : SET_SFT_MODE

 21024                                  ; Procedure Name : Check_Access

 21026                                  ; Inputs:

 21028                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 21029                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 21030                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 21031                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 21032                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 21033                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 21034                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 21035                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 21036                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 21037                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 21038                                  ; Function:
 21039                                  ;	Check this access mode for correctness
 21040                                  ; Outputs:

 21042                                  ;	Carry Clear
 21043                                  ;		Mode is correct
 21044                                  ;		AX unchanged
 21045                                  ;	Carry Set
 21046                                  ;		Mode is bad
 21047                                  ;		AX = error_invalid_access
 21048                                  ; No other registers effected
 21049                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 21417                                  ; =============== S U B R O U T I N E =======================================
 21418                                  
 21419                                  ; write FSINFO sector onto disk
 21420                                  
 21421                                  ; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 21422                                  ; --------------------------------
 21423                                  ; FAT32 FSInfo Sector Structure
 21424                                  ; --------------------------------
 21425                                  ; ref: Microsoft FAT32 File System Specification (2000)
 21426                                  
 21427                                  struc FSINFO		; Offset ;
 21428 00000000 ????????                .LeadSig:	resb 4	  ; 0		; Value 0x41615252. Lead Signature.
 21429 00000004 <res 1E0h>              .Reserved1:	resb 480  ; 4		; Reserved. Must be 0. Never be used.
 21430 000001E4 ????????                .StrucSig:	resb 4	  ; 484		; Value 0x61417272. Fields Signature.
 21431 000001E8 ????????                .Free_Count:	resb 4	  ; 488		; Last known free cluster count. (*) 
 21432 000001EC ????????                .Nxt_Free:	resb 4	  ; 492		; Start clus for free clus srch. (**)
 21433 000001F0 <res Ch>                .Reserved2:	resb 12	  ; 496		; Reserved. Must be 0. Never be used.
 21434 000001FC ????????                .TrailSig:	resb 4	  ; 508		; Value 0xAA550000. Trail Signature.
 21435                                  .size:
 21436                                  endstruc
 21437                                  
 21438                                  ; (*) If the value is 0xFFFFFFFF, then the free count is unknown
 21439                                  ;     and must be computed.
 21440                                  ; (**) If the value is 0xFFFFFFFF, then free cluster search must be started
 21441                                  ;     from cluster 2.
 21442                                  ; Lead Signature, Fields (Structure) Signature and Trail Signature
 21443                                  ; are used to validate FSInfo sector.
 21444                                  
 21445                                  ; --------------------------------
 21446                                  
 21447                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 21448                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:7436h
 21449                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:7227h)
 21450                                  
 21451                                  update_fat32_fsinfo:
 21452 00003381 51                      	push	cx
 21453 00003382 52                      	push	dx
 21454 00003383 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx
 21455                                  	;mov	dx,[es:bp+25h]
 21456 00003385 268B5625                	mov	dx,[es:bp+DPB.FSINFO_SECTOR]
 21457                                  	;cmp	[es:bp+0Fh],cx
 21458 00003389 26394E0F                	cmp	[es:bp+DPB.FAT_SIZE],cx ; 0
 21459                                  				; (16bit FAT size field = 0 for FAT32 fs)
 21460 0000338D 7505                    	jne	short u_fat32_inf_1
 21461 0000338F 83FAFF                  	cmp	dx,0FFFFh ; -1

 21495                                  					;  if it's dirty.

 21571                                  
 21572                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_SEARCH - Internal SEARCH calls for MS-DOS
 21573                                  ;	NAME	DOS_SEARCH
 21574                                  
 21575                                  ;**	Low level routines for doing local and NET directory searches
 21576                                  ;
 21577                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 21578                                  ;	DOS_SEARCH_NEXT
 21579                                  ;	RENAME_NEXT
 21580                                  ;
 21581                                  ;	Revision history:
 21582                                  ;
 21583                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 21584                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 21585                                  ;	    A001	PTM 3564 -- search for fastopen
 21586                                  
 21587                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 21588                                  
 21589                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21590                                  ;
 21591                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 21592                                  ;
 21593                                  ; Inputs:
 21594                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 21595                                  ;		terminated)
 21596                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 21597                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 21598                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 21599                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 21600                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 21601                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 21602                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer
 21603                                  ; Function:
 21604                                  ;	Initiate a search for the given file spec
 21605                                  ; Outputs:
 21606                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 21607                                  ;	    The 53 bytes ot DMAADD are filled in as follows:
 21608                                  ;
 21609                                  ;	LOCAL
 21610                                  ;	    Drive Byte (A=1, B=2, ...) High bit clear
 21611                                  ;		NEVER STORE DRIVE BYTE AFTER  found_it
 21612                                  ;	    11 byte search name with Meta chars in it
 21613                                  ;	    Search Attribute Byte, attribute of search
 21614                                  ;	    WORD LastEnt value
 21615                                  ;	    WORD DirStart
 21616                                  ;	    4 byte pad
 21617                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 21618                                  ;	NET
 21619                                  ;	    21 bytes First byte has high bit set
 21620                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 21621                                  ;
 21622                                  ;	CARRY SET
 21623                                  ;	    AX = error code
 21624                                  ;		error_no_more_files
 21625                                  ;			No match for this file
 21626                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 21627                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 21628                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 21629                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 21630                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 21631                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21632                                  
 21633                                  ; 11/05/2025
 21634                                  ; 03/03/2025 (MiniDOS)
 21635                                  ; 24/01/2024
 21636                                  %if 0
 21637                                  	; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 22096                                  ;**
 22097                                  ;
 22098                                  ; Internal Abort call closes all handles and FCBs associated with a process.
 22099                                  ;  If process has NET resources a close all is sent out over the net.
 22100                                  ;
 22101                                  ;   DOS_ABORT
 22102                                  ;
 22103                                  ;   Modification history:
 22104                                  ;
 22105                                  ;       Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 22106                                  ;
 22107                                  ;	M038	SR	10/16/90	Free SFT with the PSP of the process
 22108                                  ;				being terminated only if it is busy.
 22109                                  ;
 22110                                  
 22111                                  ;Break   <DOS_ABORT -- CLOSE all files for process>
 22112                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22113                                  ;
 22114                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_ABORT
 22115                                  ;
 22116                                  ; Inputs:
 22117                                  ;       [CurrentPDB] set to PID of process aborting
 22118                                  ; Function:
 22119                                  ;       Close all files and free all SFTs for this PID
 22120                                  ; Returns:
 22121                                  ;       None
 22122                                  ; All destroyed except stack
 22123                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22124                                  
 22125                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 22126                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:7685h
 22127                                  	; (Win ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:74F4h) 
 22128                                  
 22129                                  DOS_ABORT:
 22130 0000357C 368E06[3003]            	MOV     ES,[SS:CurrentPDB]	; SS override
 22131 00003581 268B0E3200              	MOV     CX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]  ; Number of JFNs
 22132                                  reset_free_jfn:
 22133 00003586 89CB                    	MOV     BX,CX
 22134 00003588 51                      	PUSH    CX
 22135 00003589 4B                      	DEC     BX                      ; get jfn (start with last one)
 22136                                  
 22137 0000358A E8F03D                  	CALL	_$CLOSE
 22138 0000358D 59                      	POP     CX
 22139 0000358E E2F6                    	LOOP    reset_free_jfn          ; and do 'em all
 22140                                  
 22141                                  ; Note: We do need to explicitly close FCBs. Reasons are as follows: If we
 22142                                  ; are running in the no-sharing no-network environment, we are simulating the
 22143                                  ; 2.0 world and thus if the user doesn't close the file, that is his problem
 22144                                  ; BUT... the cache remains in a state with garbage that may be reused by the
 22145                                  ; next process. We scan the set and blast the ref counts of the FCBs we own.
 22146                                  ;
 22147                                  ; If sharing is loaded, then the following call to close process will
 22148                                  ; correctly close all FCBs. We will then need to walk the list AFTER here.
 22149                                  ;
 22150                                  ; Finally, the following call to NET_Abort will cause an EOP to be sent to all
 22151                                  ; known network resources. These resources are then responsible for cleaning
 22152                                  ; up after this process.
 22153                                  ;
 22154                                  ; Sleazy, eh?
 22155                                  
 22156                                  	;context DS			; SS is DOSDATA
 22157 00003590 16                      	push	ss
 22158 00003591 1F                      	pop	ds  ; 09/09/2018
 22159                                  
 22160                                  	;CallInstall Net_Abort, MultNET, 29
 22161 00003592 B81D11                  	mov	ax,111Dh
 22162 00003595 CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR 
 22163                                  			;	    - CLOSE ALL REMOTE FILES FOR PROCESS
 22164                                  			; DS???, SS = DOS CS
 22165                                  ;if installed
 22166 00003597 FF1E[A000]              	call	far [JShare+(4*4)]	; 4 = MFTCloseP
 22167                                  ;else
 22168                                  ;	call 	MFTCloseP
 22169                                  ;endif
 22170                                  
 22171                                  ; Scan the FCB cache for guys that belong to this process and zap their ref
 22172                                  ; counts.
 22173                                  					; SS override
 22174 0000359B 36C43E[4000]            	les     di,[ss:SFTFCB]		; grab the pointer to the table
 22175                                  
 22176                                  	;;;
 22177                                  	; 03/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0

 22216                                  	;;;

 22302                                  ;Break <DOS_CLOSE -- CLOSE FILE from SFT>

 22305                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_CLOSE
 22306                                  ;
 22307                                  ; Inputs:

 22309                                  ; Function:
