 22350                                  			; ES:DI -> SFT

 23061                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_MkDir

 23065                                  ;		terminated)
 23066                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 23067                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else

 23072                                  ;	Make a new directory

 24738                                  ;Break	<DIRREAD -- READ A DIRECTORY SECTOR>
 24739                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24740                                  ;
 24741                                  ; Procedure Name : DIRREAD
 24742                                  ;
 24743                                  ; Inputs:
 24744                                  ;	AX = Directory block number (relative to first block of directory)
 24745                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 24746                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = First sector of first cluster of directory
 24747                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster
 24748                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 24749                                  ; Function:
 24750                                  ;	Read the directory block into [CURBUF].
 24751                                  ; Outputs:
 24752                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM] = Next cluster (after the one skipped to)
 24753                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] Set
 24754                                  ;	ES:BP unchanged
 24755                                  ;	[CURBUF] Points to Buffer with dir sector
 24756                                  ;	Carry set if error (user said FAIL to I 24)
 24757                                  ; DS preserved, all other registers destroyed.
 24758                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24759                                  
 24760                                  ;hkn; called from dir.asm. DS already set up to DOSDATA.
 24761                                  
 24762                                  ; 08/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 24763                                  
 24764                                  DIRREAD:
 24765                                  
 24766                                  ; Note that ClusFac is the sectors per cluster. This is NOT necessarily
 24767                                  ; the same as what is in the DPB! In the case of the root directory, we have
 24768                                  ; ClusFac = # sectors in the root directory. The root directory is detected
 24769                                  ; by DIRStart = 0.
 24770                                  
 24771 00003D56 31D2                    	XOR	DX,DX
 24772                                  	; 08/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1)

 25181                                  ;Break	<DSKREAD -- PHYSICAL DISK READ>
 25182                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25183                                  ;
 25184                                  ; Procedure Name : DSKREAD
 25185                                  ;
 25186                                  ; Inputs:
 25187                                  ;	DS:BX = Transfer addr
 25188                                  ;	CX = Number of sectors
 25189                                  ;	[HIGH_SECTOR] = Absolute record number (HIGH)
 25190                                  ;	DX = Absolute record number	       (LOW)
 25191                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 25192                                  ; Function:
 25193                                  ;	Call BIOS to perform disk read
 25194                                  ; Outputs:
 25195                                  ;	DI = CX on entry
 25196                                  ;	CX = Number of sectors unsuccessfully transfered
 25197                                  ;	AX = Status word as returned by BIOS (error code in AL if error)
 25198                                  ;	Zero set if OK (from BIOS) (carry clear)
 25199                                  ;	Zero clear if error (carry clear)
 25200                                  ; SI Destroyed, others preserved
 25201                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25202

 26136                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26137                                  ;
 26138                                  ; Procedure Name : DskRdBufScan
 26139                                  ;
 26140                                  ; Inputs:
 26141                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors read. (These constitute a block of
 26142                                  ;            sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 26143                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 26144                                  ;       [TEMP_VAR2]:[TEMP_VAR] = Transfer address (destination data address).
 26145                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 26146                                  ;
 26147                                  ; Function:
 26148                                  ;	The Buffer Queue is scanned: the contents of any dirty buffers are
 26149                                  ;	"read" into the transfer memory block, so that the transfer memory
 26150                                  ;	reflects the most recent data.
 26151                                  ;
 26152                                  ; Outputs:
 26153                                  ;       Transfer memory updated as required.
 26154                                  ;
 26155                                  ; Uses:
 26156                                  ;       DS,AX,BX,CX,SI,DI destroyed.
 26157                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 26158                                  ;
 26159                                  ; Notes:
 26160                                  ;       FIRST_BUFF_ADDR is set-up to contain the LAST buffer to check, rather
 26161                                  ;	than the FIRST.
 26162                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26163                                  ;M039: Created
 26164                                  
 26165                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 26166                                  ; DOSCODE:78F0h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 26167                                  
 26168                                  ; 18/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 26169                                  ; DOSCODE:78DCh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 26170                                  
 26171                                  ; 09/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 26172                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8313h
 26173                                  
 26174                                  ;procedure DskRdBufScan,NEAR
 26175                                  ;
 26176                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 26177                                  
 26178                                  DskRdBufScan:
 26179 0000413C 36833E[7100]00          	cmp	word [ss:DirtyBufferCount],0 ; Any dirty buffers?
 26180 00004142 743C                    	je	short bufx		     ; -no, skip all work.
 26181                                  
 26182 00004144 368B1E[0706]            	mov     bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]
 26183 00004149 89DE                    	mov     si,bx
 26184 0000414B 01D1                    	add     cx,dx
 26185 0000414D 83D600                  	adc     si,0
 26186                                  
 26187 00004150 E89723                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> 1st buf in queue.
 26188                                  	;mov	ax,[di+2]
 26189 00004153 8B4502                  	mov     ax,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_prev]
 26190 00004156 36A3[1711]              	mov     [ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR],ax
 26191                                  		
 26192                                  	; 18/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 26193                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 26194                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 26195                                  	; 15/12/2022
 26196 0000415A 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 26197                                  
 26198                                  ;       BX:DX = Extent start.
 26199                                  ;       SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 26200                                  ;          AL = Drive #.
 26201                                  ;       DS:DI-> 1st buffer in queue.
 26202                                  ;[FIRST_BUFF_ADDR] = Address offset of last buffer in queue.
 26203                                  
 26204                                  bufq:	
 26205                                  	;cmp	al,[di+4]
 26206 0000415E 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 26207 00004161 7514                    	jne	short bufq1        	;  -no, jump.
 26208                                  
 26209                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 26210                                  ;       ja	short bufq1		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 26211                                  
 26212                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 26213 00004163 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 26214 00004166 7503                    	jne	short bufq01
 26215                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 26216 00004168 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 26217                                  bufq01:
 26218 0000416B 770A                    	ja	short bufq1
 26219                                  
 26220                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 26221                                  ;       ja	short bufq2		;Jump if Extent end >= buffer sector.
 26222                                  
 26223                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 26224 0000416D 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 26225 00004170 7503                    	jne	short bufq02
 26226                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 26227 00004172 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 26228                                  bufq02:

 27338                                  ;Break   <DskWrtBufPurge -- Disk Write Buffer Purge>
 27339                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27340                                  ;
 27341                                  ; Procedure Name : DskWrtBufPurge
 27342                                  ;
 27343                                  ; Inputs:
 27344                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors to write. (These constitute a block of
 27345                                  ;	     sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 27346                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 27347                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 27348                                  ;
 27349                                  ; Function:
 27350                                  ;       Purge the Buffer Queue and the Secondary Cache of any buffers which
 27351                                  ;	are in Extent; they are being over-written.
 27352                                  ;
 27353                                  ; Outputs:
 27354                                  ;       (Same as Input.)
 27355                                  ; Uses:
 27356                                  ;       All registers except DS,AX,SI,DI preserved.
 27357                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 27358                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27359                                  ;M039: Created
 27360                                  
 27361                                  ;procedure   DskWrtBufPurge,NEAR
 27362                                  ;
 27363                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 27364                                  
 27365                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27366                                  ; DOSCODE:7C0Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27367                                  
 27368                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27369                                  ; DOSCODE:7BD4h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27370                                  
 27371                                  ; 10/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 27372                                  ; DOSCODE:8714h (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 27373                                  
 27374                                  ; NOTE: Secondary (Buffer) Cache is not used in PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 27375                                  
 27376                                  ; (Win ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:BB93h)
 27377                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS - DOSCODE:7C0Eh)
 27378                                  
 27379                                  DskWrtBufPurge:
 27380                                  	;SaveReg <bx,cx>
 27381 0000450C 53                      	push	bx
 27382 0000450D 51                      	push	cx
 27383                                  
 27384 0000450E 368B1E[0706]            	mov	bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	;BX:DX = Extent start (sector #).
 27385 00004513 89DE                    	mov	si,bx
 27386 00004515 01D1                    	add	cx,dx
 27387 00004517 83D600                  	adc	si,0                    ;SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 27388                                  
 27389                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 27390                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 27391                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 27392                                  	; 15/12/2022
 27393 0000451A 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 27394                                  
 27395                                  ; 10/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 27396                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 27397                                  %if 0
 27398                                  
 27399                                  ;	BX:DX = Extent start.
 27400                                  ;	SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 27401                                  ;	AL = Drive #
 27402                                  
 27403                                  	cmp	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0 ;Secondary cache in-use?
 27404                                  	je	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 27405                                  
 27406                                  ;	If any of the sectors to be written are in the secondary cache (SC),
 27407                                  ;	invalidate the entire SC. (This is an optimization; we really only
 27408                                  ;	need to invalidate those sectors which intersect, but that's slower.)
 27409                                  
 27410                                  	cmp	al,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	;Same drive?
 27411                                  	jne	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 27412                                  
 27413                                  	push    ax
 27414                                  	mov     ax,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]
 27415                                  	mov     di,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]	;DI:AX = SC start.
 27416                                  
 27417                                  	;Cmp32	si,cx,di,ax		;Extent end < SC start?
 27418                                  	;jbe	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 27419                                  
 27420                                  	cmp	si,di
 27421                                  	jne	short sc01
 27422                                  	cmp	cx,ax
 27423                                  sc01: 
 27424                                  	jbe	short sc5
 27425                                  
 27426                                  	add	ax,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]
 27427                                  	adc	di,0                    ;DI:AX = SC end + 1.
 27428                                  	
 27429                                  	;Cmp32	bx,dx,di,ax             ;Extent start > SC end?
 27430                                  	;jae	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 27431                                  
 27432                                  	cmp	bx,di
 27433                                  	jne	short sc02
 27434                                  	cmp	dx,ax
 27435                                  sc02:
 27436                                  	jnb	short sc5
 27437                                  
 27438                                  	mov	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	;Extent intersects SC: invalidate SC.
 27439                                  sc5:	
 27440                                  	pop     ax
 27441                                  
 27442                                  %endif
 27443                                  
 27444                                  ;	Free any buffered sectors which are in Extent; they are being over-
 27445                                  ;	written.
 27446                                  
 27447                                  nosc:	
 27448 0000451E E8C91F                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> first buffer in queue.
 27449                                  
 27450                                  _bufq:	
 27451                                  	;cmpo	al,[di+4]
 27452 00004521 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 27453 00004524 7527                    	jne	short bufq5		; -no, jump.
 27454                                  
 27455                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 27456                                  ;       ja	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 27457                                  
 27458                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 27459 00004526 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 27460 00004529 7503                    	jne	short bufq04
 27461                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 27462 0000452B 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 27463                                  bufq04:
 27464 0000452E 771D                    	ja	short bufq5
 27465                                  
 27466                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 27467                                  ;       jbe	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent end < buffer sector.
 27468                                  
 27469                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 27470 00004530 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 27471 00004533 7503                    	jne	short bufq05
 27472                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 27473 00004535 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 27474                                  bufq05:
 27475 00004538 7613                    	jbe	short bufq5
 27476                                  
 27477                                  ;	Buffer's sector is in Extent, so free it; it is being over-written.
 27478                                  
 27479                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 27480 0000453A F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 27481 0000453E 7403                    	jz	short bufq4		; -no, jump.
 27482 00004540 E8BE22                  	call	DEC_DIRTY_COUNT		; -yes, decrement dirty count.
 27483                                  bufq4:
 27484                                  	;mov	word [di+4],20FFh
 27485 00004543 C74504FF20              	mov     word [di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID],((buf_visit<<8)|0FFh)
 27486                                  
 27487 00004548 E8B11F                  	call	SCANPLACE
 27488 0000454B EB02                    	jmp     short bufq6
 27489                                  bufq5: 
 27490 0000454D 8B3D                    	mov     di,[di]
 27491                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next]
 27492                                  bufq6: 
 27493 0000454F 363B3E[1711]            	cmp	di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 27494 00004554 75CB                    	jne	short _bufq		; --no, go do next buffer.
 27495                                  	
 27496                                  	;RestoreReg <cx,bx>
 27497 00004556 59                      	pop	cx
 27498 00004557 5B                      	pop	bx
 27499 00004558 C3                      	retn
 27500                                  
 27501                                  ;EndProc DskWrtBufPurge
 27502                                  
 27503                                  ;Break   <DIV32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT DIVIDE>
 27504                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27505                                  ;
 27506                                  ; Procedure Name : DIV32
 27507                                  ;
 27508                                  ; Inputs:
 27509                                  ;       DX:AX = 32 bit dividend   BX= divisor
 27510                                  ; Function:
 27511                                  ;       Perform 32 bit division:  DX:AX/BX = CX:AX + DX (rem.)
 27512                                  ; Outputs:
 27513                                  ;       CX:AX = quotient , DX= remainder
 27514                                  ; Uses:
 27515                                  ;       All registers except AX,CX,DX preserved.
 27516                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27517                                  ;M039: DIV32 optimized for divisor of 512 (common sector size).
 27518                                  
 27519                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27520                                  ; DOSCODE:7C94h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27521                                  
 27522                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27523                                  ; DOSCODE:7C5Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 27524                                  
 27525                                  DIV32:
 27526 00004559 81FB0002                	cmp	bx,512
 27527 0000455D 7515                    	jne	short div5
 27528                                  
 27529 0000455F 89D1                    	mov	cx,dx
 27530 00004561 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax           ; CX:AX = Dividend
 27531 00004563 81E2FF01                	and	dx,(512-1)      ; DX = Remainder
 27532 00004567 88E0                    	mov	al,ah
 27533 00004569 88CC                    	mov	ah,cl
 27534 0000456B 88E9                    	mov	cl,ch
 27535 0000456D 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 27536 0000456F D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 27537 00004571 D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1
 27538 00004573 C3                      	retn
 27539                                  div5:	
 27540 00004574 89C1                    	mov	cx,ax
 27541 00004576 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx
 27542 00004578 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 27543 0000457A F7F3                    	div	bx              ; 0:AX/BX
 27544 0000457C 91                      	xchg	cx,ax
 27545 0000457D F7F3                    	div	bx              ; DX:AX/BX
 27546 0000457F C3                      	retn
 27547                                  
 27548                                  ;Break   <SHR32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT SHIFT RIGHT>
 27549                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27550                                  ;
 27551                                  ; Procedure Name : SHR32
 27552                                  ;
 27553                                  ; Inputs:
 27554                                  ;	DX:AX = 32 bit sector number
 27555                                  ; Function:
 27556                                  ;       Perform 32 bit shift right
 27557                                  ; Outputs:
 27558                                  ;	AX = cluster number
 27559                                  ;	ZF = 1 if no error
 27560                                  ;	   = 0 if error (cluster number > 64k)
 27561                                  ; Uses:
 27562                                  ;       DX,CX
 27563                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27564                                  ; M017	- SHR32 rewritten for better performance
 27565                                  ; M039	- Additional optimization
 27566                                  
 27567                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27568                                  ; DOSCODE:7CBBh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27569                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27570                                  ; DOSCODE:7C81h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 27571                                  
 27572                                  SHR32:
 27573                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]
 27574 00004580 268A4E05                	mov	cl,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_SHIFT]
 27575 00004584 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch	    ;ZF=1
 27576 00004586 E306                    	jcxz	norota
 27577                                  rotashft2:
 27578 00004588 D1EA                    	shr	dx,1	    ;ZF reflects state of DX.
 27579 0000458A D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1	    ;ZF not affected.
 27580 0000458C E2FA                    	loop	rotashft2
 27581                                  norota:
 27582 0000458E C3                      	retn

 27593                                  ;Break	<FINDENTRY -- LOOK FOR AN ENTRY>
 27594                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27595                                  ;
 27596                                  ; Procedure Name : FINDENTRY,SEARCH
 27597                                  ;
 27598                                  ; Inputs:
 27599                                  ;	[THISDPB] set
 27600                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 27601                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Starting directory sector number
 27602                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster of directory
 27603                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 27604                                  ;	[NAME1] = Name to look for
 27605                                  ; Function:
 27606                                  ;	Find file name in disk directory.
 27607                                  ;	"?" matches any character.
 27608                                  ; Outputs:
 27609                                  ;	Carry set if name not found
 27610                                  ;	ELSE
 27611                                  ;	Zero set if attributes match (always except when creating)
 27612                                  ;	AH = Device ID (bit 7 set if not disk)
 27613                                  ;	[THISDPB] = Base of drive parameters
 27614                                  ;	DS = DOSGROUP
 27615                                  ;	ES = DOSGROUP
 27616                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer into directory buffer
 27617                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI = Pointer to First Cluster field in directory entry
 27618                                  ;	[CURBUF] has directory record with match
 27619                                  ;	[NAME1] has file name
 27620                                  ;	[LASTENT] is entry number of the entry
 27621                                  ; All other registers destroyed.
 27622                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27623                                  
 27624                                  ;hkn; called from rename.asm and dir2.asm. DS must be already set up at
 27625                                  ;hkn; this point.
 27626                                  
 27627                                  SEARCH:
 27628                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27629                                  	; DOSCODE:7C90h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 27630                                  
 27631                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 27632                                  	; DOSCODE:7CCAh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 27633                                  
 27634                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 27635                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3) - Offset 45B3h
 27636                                  	; 15/03/2018 - Retro DOS v2.0
 27637                                  
 27638                                  	; 24/01/2024
 27639                                  
 27640                                  	; 13/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 27641                                  	; DOSCODE:8797h (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)
 27642                                  
 27643                                  	;entry	FindEntry
 27644                                  FINDENTRY:
 27645 0000458F E8D405                  	call	STARTSRCH
 27646 00004592 A0[6B05]                	MOV	AL,[ATTRIB]
 27647                                  	;and	al,9Eh
 27648 00004595 24DE                    	AND	AL,~attr_ignore		; Ignore useless bits
 27649                                  	;cmp	al,8
 27650 00004597 3C08                    	CMP	AL,attr_volume_id	; Looking for vol ID only ?
 27651 00004599 7503                    	JNZ	short NOTVOLSRCH	; No
 27652 0000459B E83402                  	CALL	SETROOTSRCH		; Yes force search of root
 27653                                  NOTVOLSRCH:
 27654 0000459E E84C01                  	CALL	GETENTRY
 27655                                  	;JNC	short SRCH
 27656                                  	;JMP	SETESRET
 27657                                  	; 24/01/2024
 27658 000045A1 724F                    	jc	short SETESRET
 27659                                  
 27660                                  	;entry	Srch

 27831                                  ; Inputs:

 28000                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28001                                  ;
 28002                                  ; Procedure Name : GETENTRY
 28003                                  ;
 28004                                  ; Inputs:
 28005                                  ;	[LASTENT] has directory entry
 28006                                  ;	ES:BP points to drive parameters
 28007                                  ;	[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[ENTLAST] set for DIR involved
 28008                                  ; Function:
 28009                                  ;	Locates directory entry in preparation for search
 28010                                  ;	GETENT provides entry for passing desired entry in AX
 28011                                  ; Outputs:
 28012                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer to next directory entry in CURBUF
 28013                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:DX = Pointer to first byte after end of CURBUF
 28014                                  ;	[LASTENT] = New directory entry number
 28015                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS] set via DIRREAD
 28016                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 28017                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28018                                  
 28019                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 28020                                  GETENTRY:
 28021                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 28022 000046ED A1[4803]                	MOV	AX,[LASTENT]
 28023                                  
 28024                                  	;entry	GETENT
 28025                                  GETENT:
 28026 000046F0 A3[4803]                	MOV	[LASTENT],AX
 28027                                  ;
 28028                                  ; Convert the entry number in AX into a byte offset from the beginning of the
 28029                                  ; directory.
 28030                                  ;
 28031 000046F3 B105                    	mov	cl,5			; shift left by 5 = mult by 32
 28032 000046F5 D3C0                    	rol	ax,cl			; keep hight order bits
 28033 000046F7 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax
 28034                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 28035                                  	;and	ax,0FFE0h
 28036                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 28037                                  	;and	ax,~(32-1)		; mask off high order bits
 28038                                  	; 16/12/2022
 28039 000046F9 24E0                    	and	al,0E0h ; ~31
 28040 000046FB 83E21F                  	and	dx,1Fh
 28041                                  	;and	dx,32-1			; mask off low order bits
 28042                                  ;
 28043                                  ; DX:AX contain the byte offset of the required directory entry from the
 28044                                  ; beginning of the directory. Convert this to a sector number. Round the
 28045                                  ; sector size down to a multiple of 32.
 28046                                  ;
 28047                                  	;mov	bx,[es:bp+2]
 28048 000046FE 268B5E02                	MOV	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.SECTOR_SIZE]
 28049 00004702 80E3E0                  	and	bl,0E0h
 28050                                  	;AND	BL,255-31		; Must be multiple of 32
 28051 00004705 F7F3                    	DIV	BX
 28052                                  	; 14/02/2024
 28053                                  	;MOV	BX,DX			; Position within sector
 28054                                  				; NOTE: This BX value is not used in DIRREAD
 28055                                  				; Erdogan Tan - 14/02/2024
 28056                                  	;PUSH	BX
 28057 00004707 52                      	push	dx
 28058                                  	;
 28059 00004708 E84BF6                  	call	DIRREAD
 28060 0000470B 5B                      	POP	BX

 28478                                  ;============================================================================
 28479                                  ; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 28480                                  ; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 28482                                  
 28483                                  ;	TITLE	DIR2 - Directory and path cracking
 28484                                  ;	NAME	Dir2
 28485                                  
 28486                                  ;Break	<GETPATH -- PARSE A WFP>
 28487                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28488                                  ;
 28489                                  ; Procedure Name : GETPATH
 28490                                  ;
 28491                                  ; Inputs:
 28492                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:\" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 28493                                  ;		terminated; d:/ (note forward slash) indicates a real device).
 28494                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 28495                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 28496                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 28497                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 28498                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 28499                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 28500                                  ;	[THISDPB] set to DPB if disk otherwise garbage.
 28501                                  ; Function:
 28502                                  ;	Crack the path
 28503                                  ; Outputs:
 28504                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk if disk file
 28505                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Unk if char device
 28506                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 28507                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 28508                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28509                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 28510                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 28511                                  ;	   Zero set
 28512                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 28513                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 28514                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 28515                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 28516                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 28517                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 28518                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 28519                                  ;	   Zero reset
 28520                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path or attribute mismatch
 28521                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 28522                                  ;	ELSE
 28523                                  ;	   [CurBuf] = -1 if root directory
 28524                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 28525                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 28526                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points into [CURBUF] to dir_first field for entry
 28527                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 28528                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 28529                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 28530                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 28531                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 28532                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 28533                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 28534                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it.
 28535                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 28536                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 28537                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 28538                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 28539                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 28540                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 28541                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 28542                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 28543                                  ; DS preserved, Others destroyed
 28544                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28545                                  
 28546                                  ;hkn; called from delete.asm, finfo.asm, mknode.asm and rename.asm.
 28547                                  ;hkn; DS already set up at this point.
 28548                                  
 28549                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 28550                                  
 28551                                  	; 15/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 28552                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:8B99h
 28553                                  
 28554                                  GETPATH:

 28557

 28856

 28885                                  ; Inputs:
 28886                                  ;	[ATTRIB] Set to get through directories
 28887                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Set to find last element
 28888                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28889                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path (no leading '/').
 28890                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 28891                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Phys sec # of first sector of directory
 28892                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Cluster # of next cluster
 28893                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors per cluster
 28894                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 28895                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 28896                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 28897                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 28898                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 28899                                  ;	[CREATING] and [DELALL] set
 28900                                  ; Function:
 28901                                  ;	Parse path name
 28902                                  ; Outputs:
 28903                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 28904                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 28905                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 28906                                  ;	[THISDPB] = ES:BP
 28907                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 28908                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 28909                                  ;	   Zero set
 28910                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 28911                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 28912                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 28913                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 28914                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 28915                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 28916                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 28917                                  ;	   Zero reset
 28918                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
 28919                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 28920                                  ;	ELSE
 28921                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 28922                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 28923                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to fcb_FIRCLUS field for entry
 28924                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 28925                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 28926                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 28927                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 28928                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 28929                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 28930                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 28931                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it,
 28932                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 28933                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 28934                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 28935                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 28936                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 28937                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 28938                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 28939                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 28940                                  ; Destroys all other registers
 28941                                  
 28942                                  	; 11/05/2025 (MiniDOS v1.0)
 28943                                  
 28944                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 28946

 29766                                  ;Break	<CheckThisDevice - Check for being a device>
 29767                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29768                                  ;
 29769                                  ;   CheckThisDevice - Examine the area at DS:SI to see if there is a valid
 29770                                  ;   device specified. We will return carry if there is a device present. 
 29771                                  ;   The forms of devices we will recognize are:
 29772                                  ;
 29773                                  ;	[path]device
 29774                                  ;
 29775                                  ;   Note that the drive letter has *already* been removed. All other forms
 29776                                  ;   are not considered to be devices. If such a device is found we change
 29777                                  ;   the source pointer to point to the device component.
 29778                                  ;
 29779                                  ;   Inputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 29780                                  ;		DS:SI contains name
 29781                                  ;   Outputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 29782                                  ;		DS:SI point to name or device

 29784                                  ;		Carry flag reset otherwise

 29786                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29787

 29789 00004CE0 57                      	push	di
 29790 00004CE1 56                      	push	si
 29791 00004CE2 89F7                    	MOV	DI,SI

 29794

 29798 00004CEB 46                      	INC	SI			; simulate LODSB
 29799                                  
 29800                                  ; We have the leading path separator. Look for DEV part.
 29801                                  
 29802 00004CEC AD                      	LODSW
 29803 00004CED 0D2020                  	OR	AX,2020h
 29804 00004CF0 3D6465                  	cmp	ax,"de"
 29805                                  	;CMP	AX,"e"<< 8 + "d"

 29807 00004CF5 AC                      	LODSB
 29808 00004CF6 0C20                    	OR	AL,20h
 29809 00004CF8 3C76                    	CMP	AL,"v"                  ; Not "v", assume not device
 29810 00004CFA 7526                    	JNZ	short NotDevice
 29811 00004CFC AC                      	LODSB
 29812 00004CFD E81C0D                  	call	PATHCHRCMP		; do we have the last path separator?
 29813 00004D00 7520                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; no. go for it.

 29816                                  ; SI and DevName may destroy DS.

 31262                                  ;Break   <MAKENODE -- CREATE A NEW NODE>
 31263                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31264                                  ;
 31265                                  ; Procedure Name : MakeNode
 31266                                  ;
 31267                                  ; Inputs:
 31268                                  ;       AL - attribute to create
 31269                                  ;       AH = 0 if it is ok to truncate a file already by this name
 31270                                  ;	AH != 0 if truncation not allowed (prexisting file is an error)
 31271                                  ;               (AH ignored on dirs and devices)
 31272                                  ;
 31273                                  ;        NOTE: When making a DIR or volume ID, AH need not be set since
 31274                                  ;               a name already existant is ALWAYS an error in these cases.
 31275                                  ;
 31276                                  ;       [WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 31277                                  ;               terminated)
 31278                                  ;       [CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 31279                                  ;               ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 31280                                  ;                Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 31281                                  ;       [THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 31282                                  ;       [THISSFT] Points to an empty SFT. EXCEPT sf_mode filled in.
 31283                                  ; Function:
 31284                                  ;       Make a new node
 31285                                  ; Outputs:
 31286                                  ;       Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk or errLOC_Unk via GetPathNoset
 31287                                  ;       CARRY SET IF ERROR
 31288                                  ;          AX = 1 A node by this name exists and is a directory
 31289                                  ;          AX = 2 A new node could not be created
 31290                                  ;          AX = 3 A node by this name exists and is a disk file
 31291                                  ;               (AH was NZ on input)
 31292                                  ;          AX = 4 Bad Path
 31293                                  ;               SI return from GetPath maintained
 31294                                  ;          AX = 5 Attribute mismatch
 31295                                  ;          AX = 6 Sharing Violation
 31296                                  ;               (INT 24 generated ALWAYS since create is always compat mode
 31297                                  ;          AX = 7 file not found for Extended Open (not exists and fails)
 31298                                  ;       ELSE
 31299                                  ;          AX = 0 Disk Node
 31300                                  ;          AX = 3 Device Node (error in some cases)
 31301                                  ;          [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSFAC],[CLUSNUM] set to directory
 31302                                  ;               containing new node.
 31303                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:BX Points to entry
 31304                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to entry.dir_first
 31305                                  ;          [THISSFT] is filled in
 31306                                  ;               sf_mode = unchanged.
 31307                                  ;          Attribute byte in entry is input AL
 31308                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 31309                                  ;
 31310                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31311                                  
 31312                                  ; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31313                                  ; DOSCODE:8925h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 31314                                  
 31315                                  ; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 31316                                  ; DOSCODE:88EAh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 31317                                  
 31318                                  ; 23/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 31319                                  ; DOSCODE:951Ah (PCDOS 7.1, IBMDOS.COM)

 31500                                  ; We have found an existing file. We have also entered it into the share set.
 31501                                  ; At this point we need to call newentry to correctly address the problem of
 31502                                  ; getting rid of old data (create an existing file) or creating a new
 31503                                  ; directory entry (create a new file). Unfortunately, this operation may
 31504                                  ; result in an INT 24 that the user doesn't return from, thus locking the file
 31505                                  ; irretrievably into the share set. The correct solution is for us to LEAVE
 31506                                  ; the share set now, do the operation and then reassert the share access.
 31507                                  ;
 31508                                  ; We are allowed to do this! There is no window! After all, we are in
 31509                                  ; critDisk here and for someone else to get in, they must enter critDisk also.

 32157                                  ;
 32158                                  ; Procedure Name : CHECK_VIRT_OPEN
 32159                                  ;
 32160                                  ; CHECK_VIRT_OPEN checks to see if we had performed a "virtual open" (by
 32161                                  ; examining the flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN] to see if it is 1). If we did, then
 32162                                  ; it calls Dev_Close_SFT to decrement the ref. count. It also resets the
 32163                                  ; flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN].
 32164                                  ; No registers affected (including flags).
 32165                                  ; On input, [THISSFT] points to current SFT.
 32166                                  ;
 32167                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32168                                  
 32169                                  CHECK_VIRT_OPEN:
 32170                                  	PUSH	AX
 32171                                  	lahf			; preserve flags
 32172                                  	CMP	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0
 32173                                  	JZ	short ALL_CLOSED
 32174                                  	mov	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0 ; reset flag
 32175                                  	push	es
 32176                                  	push	di
 32177                                  	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 32178                                  	call	DEV_CLOSE_SFT
 32179                                  	pop	di
 32180                                  	pop	es
 32181                                  
 32182                                  ALL_CLOSED:
 32183                                  	sahf			; restore flags
 32184                                  	POP	AX
 32185                                  	retn

 32441                                  ;Break  <BUFSEC -- BUFFER A SECTOR AND SET UP A TRANSFER>
 32442                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32443                                  ;
 32444                                  ; Procedure Name : BUFSEC
 32445                                  ;
 32446                                  ; Inputs:
 32447                                  ;       AH = priority of buffer
 32448                                  ;       AL = 0 if buffer must be read, 1 if no pre-read needed
 32449                                  ;       ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 32450                                  ;       [CLUSNUM] = Physical cluster number
 32451                                  ;       [SECCLUSPOS] = Sector position of transfer within cluster
 32452                                  ;       [BYTCNT1] = Size of transfer
 32453                                  ; Function:
 32454                                  ;       Insure specified sector is in buffer, flushing buffer before
 32455                                  ;       read if necessary.
 32456                                  ; Outputs:
 32457                                  ;       ES:DI = Pointer to buffer

 32459                                  ;       CX = Number of bytes

 32462                                  ;       Carry set if error (user FAILed to I 24)

 32464                                  
 32465                                  	; 25/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 32466                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:98C2h
 32467                                  
 32468                                  	; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8BF1h) - Retro DOS v4.0 (& v4.1)
 32469                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8C2Ch) - Retro DOS v4.2
 32470                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0BE33h)
 32471                                  
 32472                                  BUFSEC:
 32473                                  	; 25/02/2024
 32474                                  	;;;

 32786                                  ;Break	<OPTIMIZE -- DO A USER DISK REQUEST WELL>
 32787                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32788                                  ;
 32789                                  ; Procedure Name : OPTIMIZE
 32790                                  ;
 32791                                  ; Inputs:
 32792                                  ;	  BX = Physical cluster
 32793                                  ;	  CX = No. of records

 32795                                  ;	  ES:BP = Base of drive parameters

 32798                                  ;	  AX = No. of records remaining
 32799                                  ;	  BX = Transfer address

 32804                                  ;	  [CLUSNUM] = Last cluster accessed
 32805                                  ;	  [NEXTADD] updated

 32808                                  ;
 32809                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32810                                  
 32811                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 32812                                  	; 27/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)

 32814                                  OPTIMIZE:
 32815 0000554B 52                      	PUSH	DX

 32824 00005557 88C4                    	MOV	AH,AL

 32826 0000555B 89CA                    	MOV	DX,CX
 32827                                  	;MOV	CX,0
 32828                                  	; 25/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 32829                                  	; 16/12/2022
 32830 0000555D 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx	; sub cx,cx
 32831                                  OPTCLUS:
 32832                                  ; AL has number of sectors available in current cluster
 32833                                  ; AH has number of sectors available in next cluster
 32834                                  ; BX has current physical cluster
 32835                                  ; CX has number of sequential sectors found so far
 32836                                  ; DX has number of sectors left to transfer
 32837                                  ; ES:BP Points to DPB

 33058                                  ; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 33059                                  ; DOSCODE:8DC2h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 33061                                  ; 30/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 33062                                  ; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset
 33063                                  
 33064                                  ;Break   <ALLOCATE -- Assign disk space>
 33065                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33066                                  ;
 33067                                  ; Procedure Name : ALLOCATE - Allocate Disk Space
 33068                                  ;
 33069                                  ;   ALLOCATE is called to allocate disk clusters. The new clusters are
 33070                                  ;   FAT-chained onto the end of the existing file.
 33071                                  ;
 33072                                  ;   The DPB contains the cluster # of the last free cluster allocated
 33073                                  ;   (dpb_next_free). We start at this cluster and scan towards higher
 33074                                  ;   numbered clusters, looking for the necessary free blocks.
 33075                                  ;
 33076                                  ;   Once again, fancy terminology gets in the way of correct coding. When
 33077                                  ;   using next_free, start scanning AT THAT POINT and not the one following it.
 33078                                  ;   This fixes the boundary condition bug when only free = next_free = 2.
 33079                                  ;
 33080                                  ;       If we get to the end of the disk without satisfaction:
 33081                                  ;
 33082                                  ;           if (dpb_next_free == 2) then we've scanned the whole disk.
 33083                                  ;               return (insufficient_disk_space)
 33084                                  ;           ELSE
 33085                                  ;               dpb_next_free = 2; start scan over from the beginning.
 33086                                  ;
 33087                                  ;   Note that there is no multitasking interlock. There is no race when
 33088                                  ;   examining the entrys in an in-core FAT block since there will be no
 33089                                  ;   context switch. When UNPACK context switches while waiting for a FAT read
 33090                                  ;   we are done with any in-core FAT blocks, so again there is no race. The
 33091                                  ;   only special concern is that V2 and V3 MSDOS left the last allocated
 33092                                  ;   cluster as "00"; marking it EOF only when the entire alloc request was
 33093                                  ;   satisfied. We can't allow another activation to think this cluster is
 33094                                  ;   free, so we give it a special temporary mark to show that it is, indeed,
 33095                                  ;   allocated.
 33096                                  ;
 33097                                  ;   Note that when we run out of space this algorithem will scan from
 33098                                  ;   dpb_next_free to the end, then scan from cluster 2 through the end,
 33099                                  ;   redundantly scanning the later part of the disk. This only happens when
 33100                                  ;   we run out of space, so sue me.
 33101                                  ;
 33102                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 33103                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 33104                                  ;                                                                          ;
 33105                                  ;   The use of FATBYT and RESTFATBYT is somewhat mysterious. Here is the
 33106                                  ;   explanation:
 33107                                  ;
 33108                                  ;   In the NUL file case (sf_firclus currently 0) ALLOCATE is called with
 33109                                  ;   entry BX = 0. What needs to be done in this case is to stuff the cluster
 33110                                  ;   number of the first cluster allocated in sf_firclus when the ALLOCATE is
 33111                                  ;   complete. THIS VALUE IS SAVED TEMPORARILY IN CLUSTER 0, HENCE THE CURRENT
 33112                                  ;   VALUE IN CLUSTER 0 MUST BE SAVED AND RESTORED. This is a side effect of
 33113                                  ;   the fact that PACK and UNPACK don't treat requests for clusters 0 and 1 as
 33114                                  ;   errors. This "stuff" is done by the call to PACK which is right before
 33115                                  ;   the
 33116                                  ;           LOOP   findfre         ; alloc more if needed
 33117                                  ;   instruction when the first cluster is allocated to the nul file. The
 33118                                  ;   value is recalled from cluster 0 and stored at sf_firclus at ads4:
 33119                                  ;
 33120                                  ;   This method is obviously useless (because it is non-reentrant) for
 33121                                  ;   multitasking, and will have to be changed. Storing the required value on
 33122                                  ;   the stack is recommended. Setting sf_firclus at the PACK of cluster 0
 33123                                  ;   (instead of actually doing the PACK) is BAD because it doesn't handle
 33124                                  ;   problems with INT 24 well.
 33125                                  ;
 33126                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 33127                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 33128                                  ;                                                                          ;
 33129                                  ;       ENTRY   BX = Last cluster of file (0 if null file)
 33130                                  ;               CX = No. of clusters to allocate
 33131                                  ;               ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 33132                                  ;               [THISSFT] = Points to SFT
 33133                                  ;
 33134                                  ;       EXIT   'C' set if insufficient space
 33135                                  ;                [FAILERR] can be tested to see the reason for failure
 33136                                  ;                CX = max. no. of clusters that could be added to file
 33137                                  ;              'C' clear if space allocated
 33138                                  ;                BX = First cluster allocated
 33139                                  ;                FAT is fully updated
 33140                                  ;                sf_FIRCLUS field of SFT set if file was null
 33141                                  ;
 33142                                  ;       USES    ALL but SI, BP
 33143                                  
 33144                                  ;callmagic  proc near
 33145                                  ;       push    ds                             ;push segment of routine 
 33146                                  ;       push    Offset MagicPatch              ;push offset for routine
 33147                                  ;       retf                                   ;simulate jmp far
 33148                                  ;                                              ;far return address is on
 33149                                  ;                                              ;stack, so far return from
 33150                                  ;                                              ;call will return this routine
 33151                                  ;callmagic  endp
 33152                                  
 33153                                  ; 27/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 33154                                  ;PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:9AC5h
 33155                                  
 33156                                  ; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8DC2h)

 33158

 33787                                  ;       Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 33788                                  ; AX,BX,DX,DI all destroyed. Other registers unchanged.
 33789                                  ;
 33790                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33791                                  
 33792                                  	; 28/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33793                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:9D13h
 33794                                  
 33795                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:8E86h)
 33796                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0C27Fh)
 33797

 33799                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 33800                                  RELEASE:
 33801 00005802 31D2                            XOR     DX,DX
 33802                                  	
 33803                                  	; 28/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 33804                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33805                                  	;;;

 33807                                  	;;;

 33812

 33814                                  RELBLKS:
 33815                                  
 33816                                  ;   Enter here with DX=0FFFFH to put an end-of-file mark in the first cluster
 33817                                  ;   and free the rest in the chain.
 33818                                  
 33819 00005808 E80707                  	call	UNPACK
 33820                                  	;jc	short RELEASE_flush
 33821                                  	;jz	short RELEASE_flush
 33822                                  	; 28/12/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33823 0000580B 7652                            jbe	short RET12 ; jna short RET12
 33824                                  				; CCONTENT_HW:DI= Content of FAT
 33825                                   				; for given cluster (next cluster)
 33826 0000580D 89F8                    	MOV     AX,DI
 33827 0000580F 52                              PUSH    DX
 33828

 33831                                  	;;;

 33834

 33838 00005817 8916[E80A]              	mov	[CLUSTNUM_HW],dx ; next cluster (hw) to be released
 33839 0000581B 89C3                    	mov	bx,ax		 ; next cluster (lw) to be released
 33840                                  	;;;

 33843                                  	;jc	short RELEASE_flush
 33844                                  	; 28/12/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)

 33846

 33848 00005822 751F                            JNZ	short NO_DEALLOC	; Was putting EOF mark
 33849                                  
 33850                                  ; 28/02/2024
 33851                                  %if 0
 33852                                  	;;cmp	word [es:bp+1Eh],-1 ; MSDOS 3.3
 33853                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+1Fh],-1 ; MSDOS 6.0
 33854                                  	CMP     word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT],-1 ; Free count valid?
 33855                                          JZ	short NO_DEALLOC	; No
 33856                                          INC	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT] ; Increase free count by 1
 33857                                  NO_DEALLOC:
 33858                                          MOV     BX,AX
 33859                                          dec     ax              	; check for "1"
 33860                                  	jz	short RELEASE_flush	; is last cluster of incomplete chain
 33861                                  %else
 33862                                  	; 28/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 33863                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33864                                  	;;;

 33866 00005828 7519                    	jnz	short NO_DEALLOC	; no, EOF (allocate, -1), (dx = 0)
 33867                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+1Fh],0FFFFh
 33868 0000582A 26837E1FFF              	cmp	word [es:bp+DPB.FREE_CNT],0FFFFh ; -1
 33869                                  					; Free count valid?
 33870 0000582F 7412                    	jz	short NO_DEALLOC	; No (dx = 0)
 33871                                  relblks_ifc:

 33873 00005831 26FF461F                	inc	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT] ; Increase free count by 1
 33874 00005835 7519                    	jnz	short NO_DEALLOC2
 33875                                  
 33876                                  	;cmp	[es:bp+0Fh],dx
 33877 00005837 2639560F                	cmp	[es:bp+DPB.FAT_SIZE],dx
 33878 0000583B 7513                    	jnz	short NO_DEALLOC2	; not FAT32
 33879

 33886                                  					; (valid 16 bit fat size is another number)

 33888                                  					; dx = 0, FAT32

 33895 00005857 48                      	dec	ax			; check for "1"	
 33896 00005858 7405                    	jz	short RET12		; is last cluster of incomplete chain

 33898                                  	;;;
 33899                                  %endif
 33900                                  
 33901 0000585A E88C06                  	call	IsEOF
 33902 0000585D 72A3                            JB	short RELEASE	; Carry clear if JMP not taken
 33903                                  
 33904                                  	; 16/12/2022
 33905                                  ; 25/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 33906                                  ; 28/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33907                                  %if 0
 33908                                  RELEASE_flush:
 33909                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 33910                                  	mov	al,[es:bp]
 33911                                  	;MOV	AL,[ES:BP+DPB.DRIVE]
 33912                                  	push	si		; FLUSHBUF may trash these and we guarantee
 33913                                  	push	cx		;  them to be preserved.
 33914                                  	push	es
 33915                                  	push	bp

 33917                                  	pop	bp
 33918                                  	pop	es
 33919                                  	pop	cx
 33920                                  	pop	si
 33921                                  %endif		; 28/02/2024

 33923                                  RET12:
