 33926                                  ;Break	<GETEOF -- Find the end of a file>
 33927                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33928                                  ;
 33929                                  ; Procedure Name : GETEOF
 33930                                  ;
 33931                                  ; Inputs:
 33932                                  ;       ES:BP Points to DPB
 33933                                  ;       BX = Cluster in a file
 33934                                  ;       DS = CS
 33935                                  ; Outputs:
 33936                                  ;       BX = Last cluster in the file
 33937                                  ;       Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 33938                                  ; DI destroyed. No other registers affected.
 33939                                  ;
 33940                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33941                                  
 33942                                  	; 28/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 33943                                  %if 0
 33944                                  GETEOF:
 33945                                  	call	UNPACK
 33946                                          jc	short RET12
 33947                                          PUSH    BX
 33948                                          MOV     BX,DI
 33949                                  	call	IsEOF
 33950                                          POP     BX
 33951                                          JAE     short RET12
 33952                                          MOV     BX,DI
 33953                                          JMP     short GETEOF
 33954                                  %else
 33955                                  	; 28/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 33956                                  	;;;
 33957                                  GETEOF4:	; **
 33958 00005860 8F06[E80A]              	pop	word [CLUSTNUM_HW] ; * ; 28/02/2024
 33959                                  GETEOF1:
 33960 00005864 89C7                    	mov	di,ax
 33961 00005866 8916[F20A]              	mov	[CLUSTERS_HW],dx ; CLUSTERS_HW:DI = Cluster Count
 33962 0000586A 58                      	pop	ax
 33963 0000586B 5A                      	pop	dx
 33964 0000586C C3                      	retn
 33965                                  
 33966                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:9D7Ch
 33967                                  GETEOF:

 33969 0000586E 50                      	push	ax

 33971 00005871 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax ; 0
 33972                                  GETEOF2:
 33973 00005873 E89C06                  	call	UNPACK
 33974 00005876 72EC                    	jc	short GETEOF1
 33975                                  		; CCONTENT_HW:DI = next cluster (cluster content)
 33976 00005878 40                      	inc	ax

 33978 0000587B 42                      	inc	dx
 33979                                  GETEOF3:

 34290                                  ;	PUBLIC	CharType
 34291                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34292                                  
 34293                                  ; Character type table for file name scanning
 34294                                  ; Table provides a mapping of characters to validity bits.
 34295                                  ; Four bits are provided for each character. Values 7Dh and above
 34296                                  ; have all bits set, so that part of the table is chopped off, and
 34297                                  ; the translation routine is responsible for screening these values.
 34298                                  ; The bit values are defined in DOSSYM.INC
 34299                                  
 34300                                  ;	      ; ^A and NUL
 34301                                  ;CharType:
 34302                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34303                                  ;	      ; ^C and ^B
 34304                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34305                                  ;	      ; ^E and ^D
 34306                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34307                                  ;	      ; ^G and ^F
 34308                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34309                                  ;	      ; TAB and BS
 34310                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34311                                  ;	      ; ^K and ^J
 34312                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34313                                  ;	      ; ^M and ^L
 34314                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34315                                  ;	      ; ^O and ^N
 34316                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34317                                  ;	      ; ^Q and ^P
 34318                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34319                                  ;	      ; ^S and ^R
 34320                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh

 34323                                  ;	      ; ^W and ^V
 34324                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34325                                  ;	      ; ^Y and ^X
 34326                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh
 34327                                  ;	      ; ESC and ^Z
 34328                                  ;	 db   LOW ((NOT FFCB+FCHK) SHL 4) OR LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK) AND 0Fh

 34333                                  ;	      ; ! and SPACE
 34334                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FCHK+FDELIM+FSPCHK)
 34335                                  ;	      ; # and "
 34336                                  ;	 db   LOW (NOT FFCB+FCHK)
 34337                                  ;	      ; $ - )

 34339                                  ;	      ; + and *

 34434                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34435                                  ;
 34436                                  ; Procedure Names : GetLet, UCase, GetLet3
 34437                                  ;
 34438                                  ; These routines take a character, convert it to upper case, and check
 34439                                  ; for delimiters.  Three different entry points:
 34440                                  ;	GetLet -  DS:[SI] = character to convert
 34441                                  ;	UCase  -  AL = character to convert
 34442                                  ;	GetLet3 - AL = character
 34443                                  ;		  [BX] = translation table to use
 34444                                  ;
 34445                                  ;	Exit (in all cases) : AL = upper case character
 34446                                  ;			      CY set if char is control char other than TAB
 34447                                  ;			      ZF set if char is a delimiter
 34448                                  ;	Uses : AX, flags
 34449                                  ;
 34450                                  ; NOTE: This routine exists in a fast table lookup version, and a slow
 34451                                  ; inline version.  Return with carry set is only possible in the inline
 34452                                  ; version. The table lookup version is the one in use.
 34453                                  ;
 34454                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34455

 34457

 34476 000059CF 7214                    	JB	short gl_2	; Already upper case, go check type
 34477 000059D1 3C7A                    	CMP	AL,"z"
 34478 000059D3 7702                    	JA	short gl_1
 34479 000059D5 2C20                    	SUB	AL,20H		; Convert to upper case
 34480

 34487

 34490                                  	; So we shall set up DS and to access FILE_UCASE_TAB in BX and also 
 34491                                  	; preserve it.

 34494                                  	; MSDOS 3.3
 34495                                  	;;XLAT	BYTE [CS:BX]	; ds as file_ucase_tab is in DOSDATA

 34504 000059E3 D7                      	XLAT			; ds as file_ucase_tab is in DOSDATA
 34505 000059E4 1F                      	pop	ds
 34506                                  
 34507                                  	; M048 - End
 34508                                  
 34509                                  ; Now check the type
 34510                                  
 34511                                  ;If TableLook
 34512                                  gl_2:

 34514 000059E5 50                      	PUSH	AX
 34515

 34517                                  	;mov	bx,CharType

 34644                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34645                                  ;
 34646                                  ;  GetCharType - return flag bits indicating character type
 34647                                  ;	Bits are defined in DOSSYM.INC. Uses lookup table
 34648                                  ;	defined above at label CharType.
 34649                                  ;
 34650                                  ;	Entry : AL = character to return type flags for
 34651                                  ;	Exit  : AL = type flags
 34652                                  ;	Uses  : AL, flags
 34653                                  ;
 34654                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34655                                  
 34656                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 34657                                  
 34658                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 34659                                  
 34660                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 34661                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 34662                                  
 34663                                  GetCharType:
 34664                                  	;cmp	al,7Eh
 34665 00005A01 3C7E                    	cmp	al,CharType_last 	; beyond end of table?
 34666 00005A03 7314                    	jae	short gct_90		; return standard value
 34667                                  
 34668 00005A05 53                      	push	bx
 34669 00005A06 BB[8959]                	mov	bx,CharType		; load lookup table
 34670 00005A09 D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; adjust for half-byte table entry size
 34671                                  	;xlat	cs:[bx] 		; get flags
 34672 00005A0B 2ED7                    	cs	xlat	
 34673 00005A0D 5B                      	pop	bx
 34674                                  
 34675                                  ; carry clear from previous shift means we want the low nibble.  Otherwise
 34676                                  ; we have to shift the flags down to the low nibble
 34677                                  
 34678 00005A0E 7306                    	jnc	short gct_80		; carry clear, no shift needed
 34679                                  
 34680                                  ; 29/02/2024
 34681                                  %if 0
 34682                                  	shr	al,1			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 34683                                  	shr	al,1
 34684                                  	shr	al,1
 34685                                  	shr	al,1
 34686                                  %else
 34687                                  	; 29/02/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 34688                                  	;;;
 34689 00005A10 51                      	push	cx
 34690 00005A11 B104                    	mov	cl,4			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 34691 00005A13 D2E8                    	shr	al,cl
 34692 00005A15 59                      	pop	cx
 34693                                  	;;;
 34694                                  %endif
 34695                                  
 34696                                  gct_80:
 34697 00005A16 240F                    	and	al,0Fh			; clear the unused nibble
 34698 00005A18 C3                      	retn
 34699                                  gct_90:
 34700 00005A19 B00F                    	mov	al,0Fh			; set all flags
 34701 00005A1B C3                      	retn

 35070                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35071                                  ;
 35072                                  ; Procedure Name : CNTHAND ( CTRLC_C HANDLER )
 35073                                  ;
 35074                                  ; "^C" and CR/LF is printed. Then the user registers are restored and the
 35075                                  ; user CTRL-C handler is executed. At this point the top of the stack has 1)
 35076                                  ; the interrupt return address should the user CTRL-C handler wish to allow
 35077                                  ; processing to continue; 2) the original interrupt return address to the code
 35078                                  ; that performed the function call in the first place. If the user CTRL-C
 35079                                  ; handler wishes to continue, it must leave all registers unchanged and RET
 35080                                  ; (not IRET) with carry CLEAR. If carry is SET then an terminate system call
 35081                                  ; is simulated.
 35082                                  ;
 35083                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35084                                  
 35085                                  	; 29/02/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 35086                                  
 35087                                  CNTCHAND:
 35088                                  	; MSDOS 6.0			; SS override
 35089                                  					; AN002; from RAWOUT
 35090                                  	;TEST	word [SS:DOS34_FLAG],CTRL_BREAK_FLAG  
 35091                                  	;JNZ	short around_deadlock 	; AN002;
 35092                                  
 35093                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 35094                                  	; (MSDOS 6.21 MSDOS.SYS DOSCODE:91C4h, 29/12/2022)
 35095 00005B71 36F606[1206]02          	TEST	byte [SS:DOS34_FLAG+1],(CTRL_BREAK_FLAG>>8)  ; 2 
 35096 00005B77 7508                    	JNZ	short around_deadlock 	; AN002;
 35097                                  
 35098 00005B79 B003                            MOV     AL,3			; Display "^C"
 35099 00005B7B E8DFC0                          CALL	BUFOUT
 35100 00005B7E E874BF                          CALL	CRLF
 35101                                  around_deadlock:
 35102 00005B81 16                              PUSH    SS
 35103 00005B82 1F                              POP     DS

 35165                                  ;

 35208

 35787                                  ;** --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35788                                  ;
 35789                                  ; reset_environment checks the DS value against the CurrentPDB. If they are
 35790                                  ; different, then an old-style return is performed. If they are the same,
 35791                                  ; then we release jfns and restore to parent. We still use the PDB at DS:0 as
 35792                                  ; the source of the terminate addresses.
 35793                                  ;
 35794                                  ; Some subtlety: We are about to issue a bunch of calls that *may* generate
 35795                                  ; INT 24s. We *cannot* allow the user to restart the abort process; we may
 35796                                  ; end up aborting the wrong process or turn a terminate/stay/resident into a
 35797                                  ; normal abort and leave interrupt handlers around. What we do is to set a
 35798                                  ; flag that will indicate that if any abort code is seen, we just continue the
 35799                                  ; operation. In essence, we dis-allow the abort response.
 35800                                  ;
 35801                                  ; output:   none.
 35802                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 36030                                  ;	TITLE	FAT - FAT maintenance routines
 36031                                  ;	NAME	FAT
 36032                                  
 36033                                  ;**	FAT.ASM
 36034                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36035                                  ;	Low level local device routines for performing disk change sequence,
 36036                                  ;	setting cluster validity, and manipulating the FAT
 36037                                  ;
 36038                                  ;	IsEof
 36039                                  ;	UNPACK
 36040                                  ;	PACK
 36041                                  ;	MAPCLUSTER
 36042                                  ;	FATREAD_SFT
 36043                                  ;	FATREAD_CDS
 36044                                  ;	FAT_operation
 36045                                  ;
 36046                                  ;	Revision history:
 36047                                  ;
 36048                                  ;	  AN000  version Jan. 1988
 36049                                  ;	   A001  PTM	      -- disk changed for look ahead buffers
 36050                                  ;
 36051                                  ;	M014 - if a request for pack\unpack cluster 0 is made we write\read
 36052                                  ;	       from CL0FATENTRY rather than disk.
 36053                                  
 36054                                  ; DOSCODE:94FAh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 36055                                  
 36056                                  ; 02/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 36057                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:A40Ch
 36058                                  
 36059                                  ;Break <IsEOF - check the quantity in BX for EOF>
 36060                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36061                                  ;
 36062                                  ; Procedure Name : IsEOF
 36063                                  ;
 36064                                  ; IsEOF - check the fat value in BX for eof.
 36065                                  ;
 36066                                  ;   Inputs:	ES:BP point to DPB
 36067                                  ;		BX has fat value
 36068                                  ;   Outputs:	JAE eof
 36069                                  ;   Registers modified: none
 36070                                  ;
 36071                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36072                                  
 36073                                  IsEOF:
 36074                                  	; 02/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0
 36075                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM
 36076                                  	;;;
 36077 00005EE9 E89801                  	call	IsFAT32			; is it FAT32 drive ?
 36078 00005EEC 730D                    	jnc	short IsEOF_FAT		; no, it has 12 or 16 bit FAT
 36079                                  
 36080                                  	; FAT32 fs
 36081 00005EEE 36813E[E80A]FF0F        	cmp	word [ss:CLUSTNUM_HW],0FFFh
 36082 00005EF5 7503                    	jnz     short IsEOF_other1	; not EOF
 36083 00005EF7 83FBF8                  	cmp     bx,0FFF8h		; 32 bit compare
 36084                                  IsEOF_other1:
 36085 00005EFA C3                      	retn 				; cf=0 -> EOF, cf=1 -> not EOF
 36086                                  
 36087                                  IsEOF_FAT:
 36088                                  	;;;
 36089                                  
 36090                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+0Dh],0FF6h
 36091 00005EFB 26817E0DF60F            	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER],4096-10 ; is this 16 bit fat?
 36092 00005F01 730B                    	JAE	short EOF16			; yes, check for eof there
 36093                                  
 36094                                  ;J.K. 8/27/86
 36095                                  ;Modified to accept 0FF0h as an eof. This is to handle the diskfull case
 36096                                  ;of any media that has "F0"(Other) as a MediaByte.
 36097                                  ;Hopely, this does not create any side effect for those who may use any value
 36098                                  ;other than "FF8-FFF" as an EOF for their own file.
 36099                                  
 36100 00005F03 81FBF00F                	cmp	bx,0FF0h
 36101 00005F07 7404                    	je	short IsEOF_other
 36102                                  
 36103 00005F09 81FBF80F                	CMP	BX,0FF8h		; do the 12 bit compare
 36104                                  IsEOF_other:
 36105 00005F0D C3                      	retn
 36106                                  EOF16:
 36107 00005F0E 83FBF8                  	CMP	BX,0FFF8h		; 16 bit compare
 36108 00005F11 C3                      	retn				; cf=0 -> EOF, cf=1 -> not EOF
 36109                                  
 36110                                  ; DOSCODE:9511h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 36111                                  
 36112                                  ;Break	<UNPACK -- UNPACK FAT ENTRIES>
 36113                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36114                                  ;
 36115                                  ; Procedure Name : UNPACK
 36116                                  ;
 36117                                  ; Inputs:
 36118                                  ;	BX = Cluster number (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 36119                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 36120                                  ; Outputs:
 36121                                  ;	DI = Contents of FAT for given cluster (may be full 16-bit quantity)
 36122                                  ;	Zero set means DI=0 (free cluster)
 36123                                  ;	Carry set means error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 36124                                  ; SI Destroyed, No other registers affected. Fatal error if cluster too big.
 36125                                  ;
 36126                                  ; NOTE: if BX = 0 then DI = contents of CL0FATENTRY
 36127                                  ;
 36128                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36129                                  
 36130                                  	; 02/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 36131                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0A44Eh
 36132                                  	;
 36133                                  	; (MSDOS 6.22 MSDOS .SYS - DOSCODE:9511h)
 36134                                  	; (Windows ME IO.SYS - BIOSCODE:0C368h)
 36135                                  
 36136                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 36137                                  	; DOSCODE:94B5h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 36138                                  
 36139                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36140                                  UNPACK:

 36549                                  ;
 36550                                  ; Procedure Name : MAPCLUSTER
 36551                                  ;
 36552                                  ; Inputs:
 36553                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 36554                                  ;	BX Is cluster number
 36555                                  ; Function:
 36556                                  ;	Get a pointer to the cluster
 36557                                  ; Outputs:
 36558                                  ;	DS:DI Points to contents of FAT for given cluster
 36559                                  ;	DS:SI Points to start of buffer
 36560                                  ;	Zero Not set if cluster data is in high 12 bits of word

 36565                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36566                                  
 36567                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36568                                  	; DOSCODE:9601h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 36865                                  ; Procedure Name : FATREAD_SFT
 36866                                  ;
 36867                                  ; Inputs:
 36868                                  ;	ES:DI points to an SFT for the drive of interest (local only,
 36869                                  ;		giving a NET SFT will produce system crashing results).
 36870                                  ;	DS DOSDATA
 36871                                  ; Function:
 36872                                  ;	Can be used by an SFT routine (like CLOSE) to invalidate buffers
 36873                                  ;	if disk changed.
 36874                                  ;	In other respects, same as FATREAD_CDS.
 36875                                  ;	(note ES:DI destroyed!)
 36876                                  ; Outputs:
 36877                                  ;	Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 36878                                  ; NOTE: This routine may cause FATREAD_CDS to "miss" a disk change
 36879                                  ;	as far as invalidating curdir_ID is concerned.
 36880                                  ;	Since getting a true disk changed on this call is a screw up
 36881                                  ;	anyway, that's the way it goes.
 36882                                  ;

 37802                                  ;       LDS     DI,[DI]

 37804                                  ;       JNZ     SHORT SETLOOP

 37874                                  ;Break	<GETCURHEAD -- Get current buffer header>

 37876                                  ; Procedure Name : GetCurHead
 37877                                  ; Inputs:
 37878                                  ;	 No Inputs
 37879                                  ; Function:
 37880                                  ;	Returns the pointer to the first buffer in Queue
 37881                                  ;	and updates FIRST_BUFF_ADDR
 37882                                  ;       and invalidates LASTBUFFER (recency pointer)
 37883                                  ; Outputs:
 37884                                  ;	DS:DI = pointer to the first buffer in Queue

 37886                                  ;       LASTBUFFER = -1

 37891                                  ; DOSCODE:98D2h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 37893                                  ; DOSCODE:9876h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 37894

 37896                                  ; PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM - DOSCODE:0AA4Bh
 37897

 37901 000064F6 36893E[1711]            	mov	[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR],di	; save first buffer address
 37902 000064FB C3                      	retn

 37948                                  ;procedure PLACEBUF,NEAR
 37949                                  
 37950                                  	; 27/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 37951                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 37952                                  PLACEBUF:

 37954

 37965 0000650C 39D8                    	cmp	ax,bx				;Buf = last?		;AN000;
 37966 0000650E 7422                    	je	short nret			;Yes, special case	;AN000;

 37968 00006512 7506                    	jne	short not_first 		;Yes, special case	;AN000;

 38166                                  ;Break	<GETBUFFR, GETBUFFRB -- GET A SECTOR INTO A BUFFER>
 38167                                  
 38168                                  ;**	GetBuffr - Get a non-FAT Sector into a Buffer
 38169                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38170                                  ;	GetBuffr does normal ( non-FAT ) sector buffering
 38171                                  ;	It gets the specified local sector into one of the I/O buffers
 38172                                  ;	and shuffles the queue
 38173                                  ; 
 38174                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = 0 means sector must be pre-read
 38175                                  ;		       ELSE no pre-read
 38176                                  ;		(DX) = Desired physical sector number	      (LOW)
 38177                                  ;		HIGH_SECTOR = Desired physical sector number (HIGH)
 38178                                  ;		(ES:BP) = Pointer to drive parameters
 38179                                  ;		ALLOWED set in case of INT 24
 38180                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error (user FAIL response to INT24)
 38181                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 38182                                  ;		CURBUF Points to the Buffer for the sector
 38183                                  ;		    the buffer type bits OF buf_flags = 0, caller must set it
 38184                                  ;	USES	AX, BX, CX, SI, DI, Flags
 38185                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38186                                  
 38187                                  ;**	GetBuffrb - Get a FAT Sector into a Buffer
 38188                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38189                                  ;	GetBuffrb reads a sector from the FAT file system's FAT table.
 38190                                  ;	It gets the specified sector into one of the I/O buffers
 38191                                  ;	and shuffles the queue. We need a special entry point so that
 38192                                  ;	we can read the alternate FAT sector if the first read fails, also
 38193                                  ;	so we can mark the buffer as a FAT sector.
 38194                                  ; 
 38195                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = 0 means sector must be pre-read
 38196                                  ;		       ELSE no pre-read
 38197                                  ;		(DX) = Desired physical sector number	     (LOW)
 38198                                  ;		(SI) != 0
 38199                                  ;		HIGH_SECTOR = Desired physical sector number (HIGH)
 38200                                  ;		(ES:BP) = Pointer to drive parameters
 38201                                  ;		ALLOWED set in case of INT 24
 38202                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error (user FAIL response to INT24)
 38203                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 38204                                  ;		CURBUF Points to the Buffer for the sector
 38205                                  ;		    the buffer type bits OF buf_flags = 0, caller must set it
 38206                                  ;	USES	AX, BX, CX, SI, DI, Flags
 38207                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 39197                                  ; Pseudo EXEC system call for DOS
 39198                                  
 39199                                  ;	TITLE	MSPROC - process maintenance
 39200                                  ;	NAME	MSPROC
 39201                                  
 39202                                  ; =========================================================================
 39203                                  ;**	Process related system calls and low level routines for DOS 2.X.
 39204                                  ;	I/O specs are defined in DISPATCH.
 39205                                  ;
 39206                                  ;	$WAIT
 39207                                  ;	$EXEC
 39208                                  ;	$Keep_process
 39209                                  ;	Stay_resident
 39210                                  ;	$EXIT
 39211                                  ;	$ABORT
 39212                                  ;	abort_inner
 39213                                  ;
 39214                                  ;	Modification history:
 39215                                  ;
 39216                                  ;		Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 39217                                  ;		AN000	version 4.0 jan. 1988
 39218                                  ;		A007	PTM 3957 - fake vesrion for IBMCACHE.COM
 39219                                  ;		A008	PTM 4070 - fake version for MS WINDOWS
 39220                                  ;
 39221                                  ;		M000	added support for loading programs into UMBs 7/9/90
 39222                                  ;
 39223                                  ;		M004 - MS PASCAL 3.2 support. Please see under tag M003 in 
 39224                                  ;		       dossym.inc. 7/30/90
 39225                                  ;		M005 - Support for EXE programs with out STACK segment and 
 39226                                  ;		       with resident size < 64K - 256 bytes. A 256 byte 
 39227                                  ;		       stack is provided at the end of the program. Note that
 39228                                  ;		       only SP is changed.
 39229                                  ;		M020 - Fix for Rational bug for details see exepatch.asm
 39230                                  ;
 39231                                  ;		M028 - 4b04 implementation
 39232                                  ;
 39233                                  ;		M029 - Support for EXEs without stack rewritten. If EXE is
 39234                                  ;			in memory block >= 64K, sp = 0. If memory block
 39235                                  ;			obtained is <64K, point sp at the end of the memory
 39236                                  ;			block. For EXEs smaller than 64K, 256 bytes are still
 39237                                  ;			added for a stack segment which may be needed if it
 39238                                  ;			is loaded in low memory situations.
 39239                                  ;
 39240                                  ;		M030 - Fixing bug in EXEPACPATCH & changing 4b04 to 4b05
 39241                                  ;
 39242                                  ;		M040 - Bug #3052. The environment sizing code would flag a
 39243                                  ;			a bad environment if it reached 32767 bytes. Changed
 39244                                  ;			to allow 32768 bytes of environment.
 39245                                  ;
 39246                                  ;		M047 - Release the allocated UMB when we failed to load a 
 39247                                  ;		       COM file high. Also ensure that if the biggest block
 39248                                  ;		       into which we load the com file is less than 64K then
 39249                                  ;		       we provide atleast 256 bytes of stack to the user.
 39250                                  ;
 39251                                  ;		M050 - Made Lie table search CASE insensitive
 39252                                  ;
 39253                                  ;		M060 - Removed special version table from the kernal and
 39254                                  ;                      put it in a device drive which puts the address
 39255                                  ;                      in the DOS DATA area location UU_IFS_DOS_CALL
 39256                                  ;		       as a DWORD.
 39257                                  ;
 39258                                  ;		M063 - Modified UMB support. If the HIGH_ONLY bit is set on
 39259                                  ;		       entry do not try to load low if there is no space in
 39260                                  ;		       UMBs.
 39261                                  ;
 39262                                  ;		M068 - Support for copy protect apps. Call ChkCopyProt to 
 39263                                  ;		       set a20off_count. Set bit EXECA20BIT in DOS_FLAG. Also
 39264                                  ;		       change return address to LeaveDos if AL=5.
 39265                                  ;
 39266                                  ;               20-Jul-1992 bens  Added ifdef RESTRICTED_BUILD code that
 39267                                  ;                      controls building a version of MSDOS.SYS that only
 39268                                  ;                      runs programs from a fixed list (defined in the
 39269                                  ;                      file RESTRICT.INC).  Search for "RESTRICTED_BUILD"
 39270                                  ;                      for details.  This feature is used to build a
 39271                                  ;                      "special" version of DOS that can be handed out to
 39272                                  ;                      OEM/ISV customers as part of a "service" disk.
 39273                                  ;

 39312                                  ; =========================================================================
 39313                                  ;BREAK <$exec - load/go a program>
 39314                                  ;	EXEC.ASM - EXEC System Call
 39315                                  ;
 39316                                  ;
 39317                                  ; Assembler usage:
 39318                                  ;	    lds     DX, Name
 39319                                  ;	    les     BX, Blk
 39320                                  ;	    mov     AH, Exec
 39321                                  ;	    mov     AL, FUNC
 39322                                  ;	    int     INT_COMMAND
 39323                                  ;
 39324                                  ;	AL  Function
 39325                                  ;	--  --------
 39326                                  ;	 0  Load and execute the program.
 39327                                  ;	 1  Load, create the program header but do not
 39328                                  ;	    begin execution.
 39329                                  ;	 3  Load overlay. No header created.
 39330                                  ;
 39331                                  ;	    AL = 0 -> load/execute program
 39332                                  ;
 39333                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39334                                  ;	    | WORD segment address of	|
 39335                                  ;	    | environment.		|
 39336                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39337                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to ASCIZ	|
 39338                                  ;	    | command line at 80h	|
 39339                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39340                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39341                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 5Ch	|
 39342                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39343                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39344                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 6Ch	|
 39345                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39346                                  ;
 39347                                  ;	    AL = 1 -> load program
 39348                                  ;
 39349                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39350                                  ;	    | WORD segment address of	|
 39351                                  ;	    | environment.		|
 39352                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39353                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to ASCIZ	|
 39354                                  ;	    | command line at 80h	|
 39355                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39356                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39357                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 5Ch	|
 39358                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39359                                  ;	    | DWORD pointer to default	|
 39360                                  ;	    | FCB to be passed at 6Ch	|
 39361                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39362                                  ;	    | DWORD returned value of	|
 39363                                  ;	    | CS:IP			|
 39364                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39365                                  ;	    | DWORD returned value of	|
 39366                                  ;	    | SS:IP			|
 39367                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39368                                  ;
 39369                                  ;	    AL = 3 -> load overlay
 39370                                  ;
 39371                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39372                                  ;	    | WORD segment address where|
 39373                                  ;	    | file will be loaded.	|
 39374                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39375                                  ;	    | WORD relocation factor to |
 39376                                  ;	    | be applied to the image.	|
 39377                                  ;	    +---------------------------+
 39378                                  ;
 39379                                  ; Returns:
 39380                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_function
 39381                                  ;	       = error_bad_format
 39382                                  ;	       = error_bad_environment
 39383                                  ;	       = error_not_enough_memory
 39384                                  ;	       = error_file_not_found
 39385                                  ; =========================================================================
 39386                                  ;
 39387                                  ;   Revision history:
 39388                                  ;
 39389                                  ;	 A000	version 4.00  Jan. 1988
 39390                                  ;

 39475                                  	; M068 - Start
 39476                                  	;
 39477                                  	; Reset the A20OFF_COUNT to 0. This is done as there is a
 39478                                  	; possibility that the count may not be decremented all the way to
 39479                                  	; 0. A typical case is if the program for which we intended to keep
 39480                                  	; the A20 off for a sufficiently long time (A20OFF_COUNT int 21 
 39481                                  	; calls), exits pre-maturely due to error conditions.
 39482                                  
 39483                                  	; MSDOS 6.0

 39485                                  
 39486                                  	; If al=5 (ExecReady) we'll change the return address on the stack
 39487                                  	; to be LeaveDos in msdisp.asm. This ensures that the EXECA20OFF
 39488                                  	; bit set in DOS_FLAG by ExecReady is not cleared in msdisp.asm
 39489

 39491                                  	;jne	short @f

 39493                                  					; Y: change ret addr. to LeaveDos.
 39494 00006823 59                      	pop	cx			; Note CX is not input to ExecReady
 39495 00006824 B9[0A04]                	mov	cx,LeaveDOS
 39496 00006827 51                      	push	cx

 41467                                  ;**	Coalesce - Combine free blocks ahead with current block
 41468                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41469                                  ;	Coalesce adds the block following the argument to the argument block,
 41470                                  ;	iff it's free.  Coalesce is usually used to join free blocks, but
 41471                                  ;	some callers (such as $setblock) use it to join a free block to it's
 41472                                  ;	preceeding allocated block.
 41473                                  ;
 41474                                  ;	ENTRY	(ds) = pointer to the head of a free block
 41475                                  ;		(di) = 0
 41476                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 41477                                  ;		  (ds) unchanged, this block updated
 41478                                  ;		  (ax) = address of next block, IFF not at end
 41479                                  ;		'C' set if arena trashed
 41480                                  ;	USES	(cx)
 41481                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41482                                          
 41483                                  Coalesce:
 41484                                  	;cmp	byte [di],5Ah ; 'Z'
 41485 00006EFC 803D5A                  	CMP     BYTE [DI],arena_signature_end
 41486                                                                          ; IF current signature = END THEN
 41487                                          ;retz				;   GOTO ok

 41490                                          ;retc				; IF no error THEN GOTO check

 41509                                  
 41510                                  ;	BREAK  <$Alloc - allocate space in memory>
 41511                                  
 41512                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 41513                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41514                                  ;**	$Alloc - Allocate Memory Space
 41515                                  ;
 41516                                  ;	$Alloc services the INT21 that allocates memory space to a program.
 41517                                  ;	Alloc returns a pointer to a free block of memory that
 41518                                  ;	has the requested size in paragraphs.
 41519                                  ;
 41520                                  ;	If the allocation strategy is HIGH_FIRST or HIGH_ONLY memory is 
 41521                                  ;	scanned from umb_head if not from arena_head. If the strategy is
 41522                                  ; 	HIGH_FIRST the scan is continued from arena_head if a block of 
 41523                                  ;	appropriate size is not found in the UMBs. If the strategy is 
 41524                                  ;	HIGH_FIRST+HIGH_ONLY only the UMBs are scanned for memory.
 41525                                  ;
 41526                                  ;	In either case if bit 0 of UmbFlag is not initialized then the scan
 41527                                  ;	starts from arena_head.
 41528                                  ;
 41529                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 41530                                  ;           MOV     BX,size
 41531                                  ;           MOV     AH,Alloc
 41532                                  ;           INT     21h
 41533                                  ;
 41534                                  ;	BUGBUG - a lot can be done to improve performance. We can set marks
 41535                                  ;	so that we start searching the arena at it's first non-trivial free
 41536                                  ;	block, we can peephole the code, etc. (We can move some subr calls
 41537                                  ;	inline, etc.) I assume that this is called rarely and that the arena
 41538                                  ;	doesn't have too many memory objects in it beyond the first free one.
 41539                                  ;	verify that this is true; if so, this can stay as is
 41540                                  ;
 41541                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = requested size, in bytes
 41542                                  ;		(DS) = (ES) = DOSGROUP
 41543                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if memory allocated
 41544                                  ;		  (ax:0) = address of requested memory
 41545                                  ;		'C' set if request failed
 41546                                  ;		  (AX) = error_not_enough_memory
 41547                                  ;		    (bx) = max size we could have allocated
 41548                                  ;		  (ax) = error_arena_trashed
 41549                                  ;	USES	All
 41550                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41551                                  
 41552                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 41553                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41554                                  ;SUBTTL $Alloc - allocate space in memory
 41555                                  ;
 41556                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 41557                                  ;           MOV     BX,size
 41558                                  ;           MOV     AH,Alloc
 41559                                  ;           INT     21h
 41560                                  ;         AX:0 is pointer to allocated memory
 41561                                  ;         BX is max size if not enough memory
 41562                                  ;
 41563                                  ;   Description:
 41564                                  ;           Alloc returns  a  pointer  to  a  free  block of
 41565                                  ;       memory that has the requested  size  in  paragraphs.
 41566                                  ;
 41567                                  ;   Error return:
 41568                                  ;           AX = error_not_enough_memory
 41569                                  ;              = error_arena_trashed
 41570                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41571

 41910                                  ;	BREAK $SETBLOCK - change size of an allocated block (if possible)
 41911                                  
 41912                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 41913                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41914                                  ;**	$SETBLOCK - Change size of an Allocated Block
 41915                                  ;
 41916                                  ;	Setblock changes the size of an allocated block. First, we coalesce
 41917                                  ;	any following free space onto this block; then we try to trim the
 41918                                  ;	block down to the size requested.
 41919                                  ;
 41920                                  ;	Note that if the guy wants to grow the block but that growth fails,
 41921                                  ;	we still go ahead and coalesce any trailing free blocks onto it.
 41922                                  ;	Thus the maximum-size-possible value that we return has already
 41923                                  ;	been allocated! This is a bug, dare we fix it? BUGBUG
 41924                                  ;
 41925                                  ;	NOTE - $SETBLOCK is in bed with $ALLOC and jumps into $ALLOC to
 41926                                  ;		finish it's work. For this reason we build the allocsf
 41927                                  ;		structure on the frame, to make us compatible with $ALLOCs
 41928                                  ;		code.
 41929                                  ;
 41930                                  ;	ENTRY	(es) = segment of old block
 41931                                  ;		(bx) = newsize
 41932                                  ;		(ah) = SETBLOCK
 41933                                  ;
 41934                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 41935                                  ;		'C' set if error
 41936                                  ;		  (ax) = error_invalid_block
 41937                                  ;		       = error_arena_trashed
 41938                                  ;		       = error_not_enough_memory
 41939                                  ;		       = error_invalid_function
 41940                                  ;		  (bx) = maximum size possible, iff (ax) = error_not_enough_memory
 41941                                  ;	USES	???? BUGBUG
 41942                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41943                                  
 41944                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)
 41945                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41946                                  ;SUBTTL $SETBLOCK - change size of an allocated block (if possible)
 41947                                  ;
 41948                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 41949                                  ;           MOV     ES,block
 41950                                  ;           MOV     BX,newsize
 41951                                  ;           MOV     AH,setblock
 41952                                  ;           INT     21h
 41953                                  ;         if setblock fails for growing, BX will have the maximum
 41954                                  ;         size possible
 41955                                  ;   Error return:
 41956                                  ;           AX = error_invalid_block
 41957                                  ;              = error_arena_trashed
 41958                                  ;              = error_not_enough_memory
 41959                                  ;              = error_invalid_function
 41960                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41961                                  
 41962                                  _$SETBLOCK:        
 41963                                  	; 04/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0

 42057                                  ;	BREAK $AllocOper - get/set allocation mechanism
 42058                                  
 42059                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 42060                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42061                                  ;**	$AllocOper - Get/Set Allocation Mechanism
 42062                                  ;
 42063                                  ;	Assembler usage:
 42064                                  ;           MOV     AH,AllocOper
 42065                                  ;           MOV     BX,method
 42066                                  ;           MOV     AL,func
 42067                                  ;           INT     21h
 42068                                  ;
 42069                                  ;	ENTRY	
 42070                                  ;		(al) = 0
 42071                                  ;		  Get allocation Strategy in (ax)
 42072                                  ;
 42073                                  ;		(al) = 1, (bx) = method = zw0000xy
 42074                                  ;		  Set allocation strategy.
 42075                                  ;		   w  = 1  => HIGH_ONLY
 42076                                  ;		   z  = 1  => HIGH_FIRST
 42077                                  ;		   xy = 00 => FIRST_FIT
 42078                                  ;		      = 01 => BEST_FIT
 42079                                  ;		      = 10 => LAST_FIT
 42080                                  ;
 42081                                  ;		(al) = 2
 42082                                  ;		  Get UMB link state in (al)
 42083                                  ;
 42084                                  ;		(al) = 3
 42085                                  ;		  Set UMB link state
 42086                                  ;		   (bx) = 0 => Unlink UMBs
 42087                                  ;		   (bx) = 1 => Link UMBs
 42088                                  ;
 42089                                  ;
 42090                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 42091                                  ;
 42092                                  ;		 if (al) = 0
 42093                                  ;		  (ax) = existing method
 42094                                  ;		 if (al) = 1
 42095                                  ;		  Sets allocation strategy
 42096                                  ;		 if (al) = 2
 42097                                  ;		  (al) = 0 => UMBs not linked
 42098                                  ;		  (al) = 1 => UMBs linked in
 42099                                  ;		 if (al) = 3
 42100                                  ;		  Links/Unlinks the UMBs into DOS chain
 42101                                  ;
 42102                                  ;		'C' set if error
 42103                                  ;		  AX = error_invalid_function
 42104                                  ;
 42105                                  ;	Rev. M000 - added support for HIGH_FIRST in (al) = 1. 7/9/90
 42106                                  ; 	Rev. M003 - added functions (al) = 2 and (al) = 3. 7/18/90
 42107                                  ;	Rev. M009 - (al) = 3 will return 'invalid function' in ax if
 42108                                  ;		    umbhead has'nt been initialized by sysinit and 'trashed
 42109                                  ;		    arena' if an arena sig is damaged.
 42110                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42111                                  
 42112                                  ; MSDOS 2.11 (& MSDOS 3.3)

 42347                                  ; Procedure Name : GetLastArena		-  M003
 42348                                  ;
 42349                                  ; Inputs	 : cx = umb_head
 42350                                  ;
 42351                                  ;
 42352                                  ; Outputs	 : If UMBs are linked
 42353                                  ;			ES = umb_head
 42354                                  ;			DS = arena before umb_head
 42355                                  ;		   else

 42357                                  ;			ES = next arena. will be umb_head if NC.
 42358                                  ;
 42359                                  ;		   CY if error
 42360                                  ;
 42361                                  ; Uses		 : DS, ES, DI, BX
 42362                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42363                                  
 42364                                  ; 14/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 42365                                  ; DOSCODE:A4D6h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)

 42882                                  ;	BREAK	<pJFNFromHandle - return pointer to JFN table entry>
 42883                                  
 42884                                  ;**	pJFNFromHandle - Translate Handle to Pointer to JFN
 42885                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42886                                  ;	pJFNFromHandle takes a file handle and turns that into a pointer to
 42887                                  ;	the JFN entry (i.e., to a byte holding the internal file handle #)
 42888                                  ;
 42889                                  ;	NOTE:
 42890                                  ;	  This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK which is called
 42891                                  ;	  at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 42892                                  ;
 42893                                  ;	ENTRY	(bx) = handle
 42894                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if ok
 42895                                  ;		  (es:di) = address of JFN value
 42896                                  ;		'C' set if error
 42897                                  ;		  (ax) = error code
 42898                                  ;	USES	AX, DI, ES, Flags
 42899                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42900                                  
 42901                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42902                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42903                                  
 42904                                  pJFNFromHandle:
 42905                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 42906                                  	;getdseg <es>			; es -> dosdata
 42907 000072C6 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 42908                                  	
 42909                                  	;MOV	ES,[cs:CurrentPDB]	; get user process data block
 42910 000072CB 268E06[3003]            	mov	es,[es:CurrentPDB]
 42911                                  
 42912                                  	;cmp	bx,[ES:32h]
 42913 000072D0 263B1E3200              	CMP	BX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]	; is handle greater than allocated
 42914 000072D5 7204                    	JB	short pjfn10		; no, get offset
 42915                                  ReturnCarry_inv_hndl: ; 05/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 42916                                  	;mov	al,6
 42917 000072D7 B006                    	MOV     AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 42918                                  ReturnCarry:
 42919 000072D9 F9                      	STC                             ; signal error
 42920 000072DA C3                      	retn				; go back
 42921                                  pjfn10: 
 42922                                  	;les	di,[es:34h]
 42923 000072DB 26C43E3400              	LES	DI,[ES:PDB.JFN_Pointer]	; get pointer to beginning of table
 42924 000072E0 01DF                    	ADD	DI,BX			; add in offset, clear 'C'
 42925                                  	;clc
 42926                                  pJFNFromHandle_error:
 42927 000072E2 C3                      	retn

 42929                                  ;BREAK <SFFromHandle - return pointer (or error) to SF entry from handle>
 42930                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42931                                  ;
 42932                                  ; Procedure Name : SFFromHandle
 42933                                  ;
 42934                                  ; SFFromHandle - Given a handle, get JFN and then index into SF table
 42935                                  ;
 42936                                  ;   Input:      BX has handle
 42937                                  ;   Output:     Carry Set
 42938                                  ;                   AX has error code
 42939                                  ;               Carry Reset
 42940                                  ;                   ES:DI has pointer to SF entry
 42941                                  ;   Registers modified: If error, AX,ES, else ES:DI
 42942                                  ; NOTE:
 42943                                  ;   This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK which is called
 42944                                  ;       at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 42945                                  ;
 42946                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42947                                  
 42948                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42949                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42950                                  
 42951                                  SFFromHandle:
 42952 000072E3 E8E0FF                  	CALL	pJFNFromHandle		; get jfn pointer
 42953                                  	;retc				; return if error
 42954 000072E6 72FA                    	jc	short pJFNFromHandle_error
 42955 000072E8 26803DFF                	CMP     BYTE [ES:DI],-1		; unused handle
 42956                                  	;JNZ	short GetSF		; nope, suck out SF
 42957                                  	;;mov	al,6
 42958                                  	;MOV	AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 42959                                  	;jmp	short ReturnCarry	; signal it
 42960                                  	; 17/12/2022
 42961                                  	; 02/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42962 000072EC 74E9                    	jz	short ReturnCarry_inv_hndl ; Retro DOS v3.0 modification
 42963                                  	;JNZ	short GetSF		; nope, suck out SF
 42964                                  	;;mov	al,6
 42965                                  	;MOV	AL,error_invalid_handle ; appropriate error
 42966                                  	;jmp	short ReturnCarry	; signal it
 42967                                  GetSF:
 42968 000072EE 53                      	push	bx			; save handle
 42969 000072EF 268A1D                  	MOV     BL,[ES:DI]		; get SFN
 42970 000072F2 30FF                    	XOR     BH,BH                   ; ignore upper half
 42971 000072F4 E80200                  	CALL    SFFromSFN               ; get real sf spot
 42972 000072F7 5B                      	pop	bx			; restore
 42973 000072F8 C3                      	retn                        	; say goodbye

 42975                                  ;BREAK <SFFromSFN - index into SF table for SFN>
 42976                                  
 42977                                  ;**	SFFromSFN - Get an SF Table entry from an SFN
 42978                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42979                                  ;	SFFromSfn uses an SFN to index an entry into the SF table. This
 42980                                  ;	is more than just a simple index instruction because the SF table
 42981                                  ;	can be made up of multiple pieces chained together. We follow the
 42982                                  ;	chain to the right piece and then do the index operation.
 42983                                  ;
 42984                                  ;   NOTE:
 42985                                  ;	This routine is called from SFFromHandle which is called
 42986                                  ;       at DOSINIT time with SS NOT DOSGROUP
 42987                                  ;
 42988                                  ;	ENTRY	BX has SF index
 42989                                  ;	EXIT	'C' clear if OK
 42990                                  ;		  ES:DI points to SF entry
 42991                                  ;		'C' set if index too large
 42992                                  ;	USES	BX, DI, ES
 42993                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42994                                  
 42995                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42996                                  	; 11/03/2024 - Retro DOS v5.0 (Modified PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 42997                                  
 42998                                  SFFromSFN:
 42999                                  	; 05/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 43000                                  	;getdseg <es>			; es -> dosdata
 43001 000072F9 2E8E06[0700]            	mov	es,[cs:DosDSeg]
 43002                                  
 43003                                  	;LES	DI,[CS:SFT_ADDR]	; (es:di) = start of SFT table
 43004 000072FE 26C43E[2A00]            	les	di,[es:SFT_ADDR]
 43005                                  sfsfn5:	
 43006                                  	;cmp	bx,[es:di+4]
 43007 00007303 263B5D04                	CMP	BX,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]	; is handle in this table?
 43008 00007307 720E                    	JB	short sfsfn7		; yes, go grab it
 43009                                  	;sub	bx,[es:di+4]
 43010 00007309 262B5D04                	SUB     BX,[ES:DI+SFT.SFCount]
 43011 0000730D 26C43D                  	les	di,[es:di] ; 14/08/2018
 43012                                  	;LES	DI,[ES:DI+SFT.SFLink]	; get next table segment
 43013 00007310 83FFFF                  	CMP     DI,-1                   ; end of tables?
 43014 00007313 75EE                    	JNZ	short sfsfn5		; no, try again
 43015 00007315 F9                      	STC
 43016 00007316 C3                      	retn				; return with error, not found
 43017                                  sfsfn7:
 43018 00007317 50                      	push	ax
 43019                                  	;;mov	ax,53 ; MSDOS 3.3
 43020                                  	;mov	ax,59 ; MSDOS 5.0 to PCDOS 7.1 (to Win ME) ; 11/03/2024
 43021                                  	;MOV	AX,SF_ENTRY.size	; put it in a nice place
 43022                                  	
 43023                                  	; 17/12/2022
 43024 00007318 B03B                    	mov	al,SF_ENTRY.size ; 28/05/2019
 43025                                  	; 07/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 43026                                  	;mov	ax,SF_ENTRY.size ; 59
 43027                                  	
 43028 0000731A F6E3                    	MUL	BL			; (ax) = offset into this SF block
 43029 0000731C 01C7                    	ADD	DI,AX			; add base of SF block
 43030 0000731E 58                      	pop	ax
 43031                                  	;add	di,6
 43032 0000731F 83C706                  	ADD	DI,SFT.SFTable		; offset into structure, 'C' cleared
 43033 00007322 C3                      	retn				; return with 'C' clear
